````less
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.contextUsageSubtitle {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.contextUsageHint {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--fn-text-quaternary, var(--fn-text-tertiary));
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.contextUsageLoading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 16px 0;
}

.contextUsageBar {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--fn-border-secondary, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08));
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.contextUsageBarSegment {
  min-width: 2px;
  height: 100%;
}

.contextUsageBarRemainder {
  height: 100%;
  background: transparent;
}

.contextUsageLegend {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.contextUsageLegendItem {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 10px 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
}

.contextUsageLegendSwatch {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.contextUsageLegendLabel {
  min-width: 0;

  &:only-child {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
}

.contextUsageLegendValue {
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.contextRingSvg {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  display: block;
}

.contextRingTrack {
  stroke: var(--fn-border-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08));
}

.contextRingProgress {
  transition:
    stroke-dashoffset 0.25s ease,
    stroke 0.25s ease;
}

.contextRingLabel {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  line-height: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.spinIcon {
  animation: chatSpin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes chatSpin {
  from {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.sendBtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: none;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--fn-color-brand),
    var(--fn-color-brand-soft)
  );
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;

  &:hover:not(:disabled) {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: var(--fn-shadow-brand-lg);
  }

  &:active:not(:disabled) {
    transform: scale(0.97);
  }

  &:disabled {
    opacity: 0.35;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

/* ---------- Queued messages: composer header strip ---------- */
.queuedMessages {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  max-height: 120px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin: -8px -10px 8px -16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary, var(--fn-bg-layout));
  border-radius: 19px 19px 0 0;

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    margin: -8px -8px 6px -14px;
  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
  }
  &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--fn-border-primary);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
}

.queuedMessageItem {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 8px 10px 8px 14px;
}

.queuedMessageIndex {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  background: var(--fn-bg-elevated, #fff);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
}

.queuedMessageBody {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
}

.queuedMessageText {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.queuedMessageAttach {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
}

.queuedMessageActions {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.queuedMessageIconBtn {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--fn-radius-full);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fn-text-quaternary);
  cursor: pointer;

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
    background: var(--fn-bg-tertiary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04));
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 1px;
  }
}

.sendBtnGroup {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ---------- Image upload & preview ---------- */
.imagePreviewBar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 0 4px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 4px;
  }
  &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--fn-border-primary);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
}

.imagePreviewItem {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: var(--fn-radius-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  line-height: 0;

  :global(.ant-image) {
    display: block;
    line-height: 0;
  }
}

.attachmentPreviewCard {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 240px;
  padding: 12px 34px 12px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--fn-radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary);
}

.attachmentPreviewMeta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.attachmentPreviewIcon {
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.attachmentPreviewName {
  display: block;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
}

.imagePreviewThumb {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.composerMediaItem {
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--fn-radius-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  line-height: 0;
}

.composerMediaVideo {
  display: block;
  width: 160px;
  height: 90px;
  object-fit: cover;
  background: #000;
}

.composerMediaAudio {
  display: block;
  width: 220px;
  height: 32px;
}

.composerMediaSkeleton {
  width: 160px;
  height: 90px;
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary);
}

.imagePreviewRemove {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  right: 2px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: background var(--fn-transition-fast);

  &:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  }
}

.imagePreviewLoading {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary);
}

.uploadSpinner {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 2px solid var(--fn-border-primary);
  border-top-color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.6s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.dropActive {
  .inputWrapper {
    border-color: var(--fn-color-brand);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--fn-color-brand-glow);
    background: var(--fn-bg-hover);
  }
}

.dropOverlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--fn-color-brand);
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--fn-bg-primary) 82%,
    var(--fn-color-brand)
  );
  color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
}

/* A right-docked workspace can narrow the chat without narrowing the viewport.
   Respond to the chat column itself so composer controls remain usable. */
@container chat-main (max-width: 560px) {
  .chatInput {
    padding-inline: 12px;
  }

  .askQuestionDock {
    padding-inline: var(--chat-column-pad-x-narrow, 12px);
  }

  .inputWrapper {
    min-width: 0;
    padding-inline: 8px;
  }

  .actionsRow {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .modeHint {
    order: 0;
    flex: 1 0 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
    padding-top: 0;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .secondaryActions {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    padding-right: 0;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;

    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .inputActions {
    max-width: 100%;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .secondaryBtn,
  .newChatBtn,
  .sendBtn {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
  }
}
````

````less
/* Message list, bubbles, tools, thinking */
/* ---------- Message list ---------- */
.messageListWrapper {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* Left gutter so the in-thread turn timeline ticks do not cover bubbles.
   Prefer parent `.chatMainWithTurnRail` (title + composer + list). This local
   class remains as a fallback when MessageList is mounted alone. */
.messageListWrapperWithRail {
  --chat-turn-rail-gutter: 48px;

  .messageListInner {
    padding-inline-start: var(--chat-turn-rail-gutter);
    padding-inline-end: var(--chat-column-pad-x, 24px);

    @media (max-width: 863px) {
      padding-inline-start: var(--chat-column-pad-x, 24px);
    }
  }
}

.messageList {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px 0 24px;
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
  /* Disable browser scroll anchoring — fights follow-mode pins while
     thinking/tool rows grow and causes visible up/down jitter. */
  overflow-anchor: none;

  /* Custom scrollbar for visual polish */
  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
  }
  &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
  }
  &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--fn-border-primary);
    border-radius: 3px;

    &:hover {
      background: var(--fn-text-quaternary);
    }
  }
}

.scrollToBottomBtn {
  /* Layout: centered, floating above the message list */
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 20px;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 20;

  /* Quiet secondary affordance — readable but not competing with messages */
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px 12px 6px 10px;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--fn-bg-elevated, var(--fn-bg-primary)) 88%,
    transparent
  );
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary, var(--fn-card-border-normal));
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  white-space: nowrap;

  transition:
    background var(--fn-transition-fast),
    color var(--fn-transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--fn-transition-fast),
    border-color var(--fn-transition-fast),
    opacity 0.22s ease,
    transform 0.22s ease,
    visibility 0.22s;

  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;

  &:hover {
    background: var(--fn-bg-elevated, var(--fn-bg-primary));
    color: var(--fn-text-primary);
    border-color: var(--fn-border-primary, var(--fn-card-border-normal));
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-1px);
  }

  &:active {
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

/* Explicit visible state — entrance from below */
.scrollToBottomBtnVisible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
  animation: scrollBtnEnter 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
}

.scrollToBottomBtnHasNew {
  color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 35%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--fn-color-brand) 8%,
    var(--fn-bg-elevated, var(--fn-bg-primary))
  );

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 50%, transparent);
  }
}

/* Hidden state — exits downward, pointer-events disabled to avoid ghost clicks */
.scrollToBottomBtnHidden {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes scrollBtnEnter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

.messageListInner {
  overflow-anchor: none;

  /* Full list width; each row centers a 960px text track + avatar gutters

  box-sizing: border-box;

/* ---------- Message bubbles ---------- */
/* Desktop: 3 columns — expert avatar | composer-aligned text | user avatar.
   Mobile (≤767): user rows and the process summary keep an avatar track.
   The final answer starts at the avatar's left edge (see overrides below). */
.chatMsgColumns() {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns:
    var(--chat-msg-avatar-slot, 48px) minmax(0, var(--chat-column-max, 960px))
    var(--chat-msg-avatar-slot, 48px);
  column-gap: var(--chat-msg-gutter, 0px);
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
}

.messageBubble {
  .chatMsgColumns();
  align-items: start;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

  background: transparent;
  line-height: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50%;

  &:hover {
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.msgAvatarPlain {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  line-height: 0;
}

.msgUserAvatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  user-select: none;

  img,
  svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

  svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
  }
}

.avatarCol {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

.botAvatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--fn-radius-full);
  background: var(--fn-bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  img,
  video {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    object-fit: contain;
  }
}

.bubbleContent {
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;

  &:hover .msgCopyBtn {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.userText {
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary-active, #e8eaed);
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 16px 16px 6px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
}

.userComposerTags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  opacity: 0.92;
}

.assistantText {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.025);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: none;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
  word-break: break-word;
  box-shadow: none;
  position: relative;
  overflow: visible;

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  // Markdown reset
  :global {
    p {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      &:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }
    }
    pre {
      margin: 10px 0;
      border-radius: var(--fn-radius-md);
      overflow-x: auto;
    }
    code {
      font-size: 13.5px;
    }
    ul,
    ol {
      padding-left: 22px;
      margin: 6px 0;
    }
    a {
      color: var(--fn-text-brand);
    }
  }
}

/* Group position variants: transparent background — no visual border differences */
.assistantText.groupFirst,
.assistantText.groupMiddle,
.assistantText.groupLast {
  padding: 2px 0;
}

/* Streaming cursor */
.cursor {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 16px;
  margin-left: 2px;
  background: var(--fn-color-brand);
  border-radius: 1px;
  vertical-align: text-bottom;
  animation: blink 0.8s steps(2) infinite;
}

@keyframes blink {
  0% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ---------- Thinking indicator ---------- */
.thinkingBubble {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
}

.thinkingContent {
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary);
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-radius: 4px 18px 18px 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.thinkingText {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  margin-left: 4px;
  animation: thinkingFadeInOut 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes thinkingFadeInOut {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.thinkingCancelBtn {
  margin-left: 8px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    color var(--fn-transition-fast),
    border-color var(--fn-transition-fast),
    background var(--fn-transition-fast);

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-color-danger);
    border-color: var(--fn-color-danger);
    background: var(--fn-bg-danger-light);
  }
}

.thinkingDot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: var(--fn-radius-full);
  background: var(--fn-color-brand, var(--fn-text-tertiary));
  opacity: 0.6;
  animation: thinkingPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;

  &:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.2s;
  }

  &:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.4s;
  }
}

@keyframes thinkingPulse {
  0%,
  80%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.3;
    transform: scale(0.8);
  }
  40% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

/* Unified bottom waiting state — fixed slot for the whole stream.
   Keep width tied to the message column: a flex slot + turnInset grid can
   resolve to the grid's preferred max (avatar gutters + 960px) after the
   session sidebar opens/closes and the chatMain width reflows. */
.generatingSlot {
  min-height: 36px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 4px 8px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;

  > * {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
}

.generatingIndicator {
  display: contents;
}

.generatingIndicator .avatarCol {
  grid-column: 1;
  justify-self: center;
  align-self: center;
}

.generatingStatus {
  grid-column: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.generatingText {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  margin-left: 4px;
}

/* ---------- Tool-only message row (no bubble wrapper) ---------- */
.toolOnlyRow {
  padding: 2px 0;
}

/* ---------- Inline tool details ---------- */
.inlineToolBlock {
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 0;
  border-top: none;
}

.inlineToolSummary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06));
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02));
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition:
    background 0.15s ease,
    border-color 0.15s ease;

  &:hover {
    background: var(--fn-bg-hover, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04));
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 20%, transparent);
  }
}

.inlineToolSummaryRunning {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 28%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--fn-color-brand) 5%,
    var(--fn-bg-secondary, #f8fafc)
  );
  animation: inlineToolRunningPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;

  .inlineToolIcon {
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  }

  .inlineToolStatus {
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  }
}

@keyframes inlineToolRunningPulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 0%, transparent);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 12%, transparent);
  }
}

.inlineToolStatusLive {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-left: auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  font-size: 12px;

  .thinkingDot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
  }
}

.inlineToolIcon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  line-height: 0;
}

.inlineToolName {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.inlineToolStatus {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-size: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.inlineToolChevron {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.inlineToolChevronOpen {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.inlineToolDetails {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02));
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06));
}

.inlineToolMediaPreview {
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.toolMediaStrip {
  margin: 8px 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.toolMediaVideo {
  max-width: min(280px, 85vw);
  max-height: 200px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #000;
}

.toolMediaImage {
  max-width: min(220px, 65vw);
  max-height: 160px;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.toolMediaFallback {
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.inlineToolSection {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.inlineToolSectionLabel {
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.inlineToolCode {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--fn-bg-quaternary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03));
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-all;
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-height: 180px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.inlineToolHint {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
}

.acpPermissionActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* ---------- Assistant turn process summary (tools + thinking) ---------- */
.processSummaryRow {
  .chatMsgColumns();
  /* Offset the 36px avatar so it centers on the original fold header
     (8+8 padding + 13px/1.4 toggle). Do not stretch the bar to 36px. */
  --chat-process-header-height: calc(16px + 13px * 1.4);
  --chat-process-avatar-size: 36px;
  align-items: start;
  max-width: 100%;

  .avatarCol {
    grid-column: 1;
    justify-self: center;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: calc(
      (var(--chat-process-header-height) - var(--chat-process-avatar-size)) / 2
    );

    .msgSender,
    .msgSenderBtn {
      padding-top: 0;
    }
  }

  .processSummary {
    grid-column: 2;
    justify-self: center;
    align-self: center;
  }
}

/* Mobile: keep the avatar beside user copy and beside the process summary.
   The final answer spans from the avatar's left edge, so it is not indented
   past that avatar. Placed after `.chatMsgColumns()` so these overrides win. */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .processSummaryRow,
  .turnInset,
  .assistantBubble {
    grid-template-columns: var(--chat-msg-avatar-slot, 44px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    column-gap: var(--chat-msg-gutter);

    .avatarCol {
      grid-column: 1;
    }

    .processSummary {
      grid-column: 2;
      justify-self: stretch;
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
    }
  }

  .turnInset > * {
    grid-column: 2;
  }

  .assistantBubble .bubbleContent {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 1;
    justify-self: stretch;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .assistantBubble:has(.avatarCol) {
    row-gap: 6px;

    .avatarCol {
      grid-row: 1;
    }

    .bubbleContent {
      grid-row: 2;
    }
  }

  .userBubble {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--chat-msg-avatar-slot, 44px);

    .bubbleContent {
      grid-column: 1;
    }

    .avatarCol {
      grid-column: 2;
    }
  }

  .userBubbleWithTags {
    .userComposerTags {
      grid-column: 1;
    }
  }
}

.processSummary {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.025);
}

/* Mobile: hide the list scrollbar. Process summary and insets keep the text
   track; the final answer still starts at the avatar's left edge. */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .messageList {
    scrollbar-gutter: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;

    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 0;
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .processSummaryRow .processSummary,
  .turnInset > * {
    grid-column: 2 / -1;
  }

  .assistantBubble .bubbleContent {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .processSummary {
    /* Match .assistantText inline padding so the fold lines up with the card. */
    padding-inline: 14px;
  }
}

.pinnedToolResults {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-top: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.pinnedToolResultItem {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.toolUiRendererWrap {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  /* Normal block flow: cards with maxWidth keep filling up to that cap;
     cards with width:100% fill the message column. Do not use fit-content /
     inline-grid here — those shrink to content width. */

  .toolUiDockActions {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
  }

  &:hover .toolUiDockActions,
  &:focus-within .toolUiDockActions {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  @media (hover: none) {
    .toolUiDockActions {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
  }
}

.toolUiDockBtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-bg-primary) 92%, transparent);
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  cursor: pointer;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 38%, transparent);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.toolUiDockPlaceholder {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--fn-border-secondary);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-bg-secondary) 70%, transparent);
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;

  &:hover {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 38%, transparent);
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.toolUiDockPlaceholderTitle {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fn-text-primary);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.toolUiDockPlaceholderHint {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.assistantTurnAnswer {
  min-width: 0;
}

.teamWrapupTurn {
  .chatMsgColumns();
  row-gap: 0;
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--fn-border-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08));

  > * {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    min-width: 0;
  }
}

.teamWrapupBadge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08));
  background: var(--fn-bg-secondary, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03));
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* Host avatar is 36px and centered in the avatar slot. Start the label there. */
.teamWrapupTurn > .teamWrapupBadge {
  grid-column: 1 / 3;
  justify-self: start;
  width: max-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-inline-start: calc((var(--chat-msg-avatar-slot, 48px) - 36px) / 2);
}

.knowledgeCitations {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.knowledgeCitationsLabel {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
}

.knowledgeCitationsList {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.knowledgeCitationChip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-border-secondary);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--fn-bg-primary);
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  cursor: pointer;

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 38%, transparent);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.knowledgeCitationName {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 14rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.knowledgeCitationKb {
  flex-shrink: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 8rem;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.openBrowserPrompt {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  /* Grid child of .turnInset — default stretch fills the message column;
     keep the chip hug its label (same idea as .messageFileCard). */
  justify-self: start;
  width: fit-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 22%, transparent);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--fn-color-brand) 5%,
    var(--fn-bg-primary)
  );
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    color 0.15s ease,
    background 0.15s ease,
    border-color 0.15s ease,
    box-shadow 0.15s ease;

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-color-brand);
    background: color-mix(
      in srgb,
      var(--fn-color-brand) 9%,
      var(--fn-bg-primary)
    );
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 38%, transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 12%, transparent);

    .openBrowserPromptArrow {
      transform: translateX(2px);
      color: var(--fn-color-brand);
    }
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--fn-color-brand);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.openBrowserPromptActive {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fn-color-brand) 42%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--fn-color-brand) 8%,
    var(--fn-bg-primary)
  );
}

.openBrowserPromptIcon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--fn-color-brand);
}

.openBrowserPromptArrow {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  transition:
    transform 0.15s ease,
    color 0.15s ease;
}

.processSummaryToggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fn-text-tertiary);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: color 0.15s ease;

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-text-secondary);
  }
}

.processSummaryToggleLive {
  color: var(--fn-text-secondary);

  &:hover {
    color: var(--fn-text-primary);
  }
}

.processSummaryText {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.processLiveHint {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--fn-color-brand);

  .thinkingDot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
}

.processLiveLabel {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  animation: thinkingFadeInOut 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.processSummaryChevron {
````

````less
    bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
    right: max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
    width: auto;
    min-width: unset;

    opacity: 0;

.sidebarResizing {

    width: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    border-right: none;
  }

.sidebarResizeHandle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: -3px;
  width: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  cursor: col-resize;
  z-index: 3;
  touch-action: none;

  &::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    width: 2px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--fn-border-secondary);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;

}

.sidebarOpen {

    opacity: 1;

    background: var(--fn-bg-hover);

}
````

````typescript
import { createContext, useContext, useMemo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { dockToolUiTabId } from "./utils/dockToolUiTabId";
import type { DockTab, DockTabId } from "./hooks/useChatDockPanel";

export interface OpenToolUiPanelOptions {
  callId: string;
  title?: string;
  toolName?: string;
}

interface ChatToolDockContextValue {
  openToolUiPanel: (opts: OpenToolUiPanelOptions) => void;
  closeToolUiPanel: (callId: string) => void;
  focusToolUiPanel: (callId: string) => void;
  isToolUiDocked: (callId: string | undefined) => boolean;
}

const ChatToolDockContext = createContext<ChatToolDockContextValue | null>(
  null,
);

export function ChatToolDockProvider({
  dockOpen,
  openTabs,
  activeTabId,
  openToolUiPanel,
  closeToolUiPanel,
  focusToolUiPanel,
  children,
}: {
  dockOpen: boolean;
  openTabs: DockTab[];
  activeTabId: DockTabId | null;
  openToolUiPanel: (opts: OpenToolUiPanelOptions) => void;
  closeToolUiPanel: (callId: string) => void;
  focusToolUiPanel: (callId: string) => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const activeToolUiCallId = useMemo(() => {
    if (!dockOpen || activeTabId == null) return null;
    const active = openTabs.find((tab) => tab.id === activeTabId);
    return active?.kind === "toolUi" ? active.callId : null;
  }, [dockOpen, openTabs, activeTabId]);

  const value = useMemo<ChatToolDockContextValue>(
    () => ({
      openToolUiPanel,
      closeToolUiPanel,
      focusToolUiPanel,
      // Placeholder only while this tool's tab is the visible dock surface.
      // Closing the dock, the tab, or switching away restores the chat card.
      isToolUiDocked: (callId) => !!callId && activeToolUiCallId === callId,
    }),
    [activeToolUiCallId, openToolUiPanel, closeToolUiPanel, focusToolUiPanel],
  );

  return (
    <ChatToolDockContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </ChatToolDockContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useChatToolDock(): ChatToolDockContextValue | null {
  return useContext(ChatToolDockContext);
}

export function dockTabIdForToolCall(callId: string): DockTabId {
  return dockToolUiTabId(callId);
````

## File: dashboard/src/pages/Chat/constants.ts
````typescript
/** Harness browser tools that activate the in-chat browser workspace. */
export const BROWSER_TOOL_NAMES = ["browser_use", "browser_control"] as const;

/** Harness tools that write into the agent workspace and open the edit-file card. */
export const FILE_TOOL_NAMES = [
  "write_file",
  "edit_file",
  "send_file",
  "send_file_to_user",
] as const;

export const EMPTY_CHAT_SESSION_KEY = "__empty__";
export const PENDING_THREAD_ID = "__pending__";

function toolNameBase(name: string): string {
  const trimmed = name.trim();
  const slash = trimmed.lastIndexOf("/");
  return slash >= 0 ? trimmed.slice(slash + 1) : trimmed;
}

export function isBrowserToolName(name: string | undefined): boolean {
  return (BROWSER_TOOL_NAMES as readonly string[]).includes(name ?? "");
}

/** Match ``write_file`` / ``edit_file`` / ``send_file`` (and ``ns/…``), not ``write_todos``. */
export function isFileToolName(name: string | undefined): boolean {
  const base = toolNameBase((name ?? "").trim()).toLowerCase();
  return (FILE_TOOL_NAMES as readonly string[]).includes(base);
}

/** Alias kept for call sites that mean "opens the chat file panel card". */
export function isWriteToolName(name: string | undefined): boolean {
  return isFileToolName(name);
}
````

````less
  --chat-msg-avatar-slot: 48px;
````
