````typescript
/**
 * ActiveModelPool — shows all resolved (enabled + authorized) models
 * grouped by provider, with a star button to set the global preferred model.
 *
 * Mirrors finnie's ActiveModelPool component.
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Brain, Check, Info, Star, X, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { Button, Empty, Popover, Segmented, Select, Tag, Tooltip } from "antd";
import { message } from "@/utils/antdMessage";

import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { request } from "../../../../../api/request";
import { preferencesApi } from "../../../../../api/modules/preferences";
import type { ProviderRow, ResolvedModel } from "../../useProviders";
import { ModelMetaTags } from "../../modelMeta";
import { modelOptionLabel } from "../../../../../utils/modelOptions";
import styles from "../../index.module.less";

interface ActiveModel {
  provider_name: string;
  model: string;
}

interface ActiveModelPoolProps {
  resolvedModels: ResolvedModel[];
  activeModel: ActiveModel;
  providers: ProviderRow[];
  modelReasoning: Record<
    string,
    { mode: "auto" | "enabled" | "disabled"; effort?: string | null }
  >;
  onSaved: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

interface GroupedModels {
  providerId: number;
  providerName: string;
  providerKind: string;
  models: ResolvedModel[];
}

export function ActiveModelPool({
  resolvedModels,
  activeModel,
  providers,
  modelReasoning,
  onSaved,
}: ActiveModelPoolProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [setting, setSetting] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [testingKey, setTestingKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState<
    Map<string, "success" | "failure">
  >(new Map());

  const providerHasKey = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<number, boolean>();
    for (const p of providers) {
      map.set(p.id, !!p.api_key);
    }
    return map;
  }, [providers]);

  const grouped = useMemo<GroupedModels[]>(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, GroupedModels>();
    for (const m of resolvedModels) {
      let group = map.get(m.provider_name);
      if (!group) {
        group = {
          providerId: m.provider_id,
          providerName: m.provider_name,
          providerKind: m.provider_kind,
          models: [],
        };
        map.set(m.provider_name, group);
      }
      group.models.push(m);
    }
    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [resolvedModels]);

  const handleSetPreferred = async (m: ResolvedModel) => {
    const isAlready =
      m.provider_name === activeModel.provider_name &&
      m.model === activeModel.model;
    if (isAlready) return;

    const key = `${m.provider_name}/${m.model}`;
    setSetting(key);
    try {
      await preferencesApi.patch({ preferred_model: key });
      message.success(
        t("models.preferredModelSet", {
          model: modelOptionLabel(m),
        }),
      );
      await onSaved();
    } catch (err) {
      message.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : t("common.saveFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setSetting(null);
    }
  };

  const handleTestModel = async (m: ResolvedModel) => {
    const key = `${m.provider_name}/${m.model}`;
    setTestingKey(key);
    try {
      const result = await request<{
        ok: boolean;
        latency_ms?: number;
        error?: string;
      }>(`/admin/providers/${m.provider_id}/test`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ model_id: m.model }),
      });
      if (result.ok) {
        message.success(
          t("models.testSuccess", {
            name: modelOptionLabel(m),
            time: result.latency_ms ?? 0,
          }),
        );
        setTestResults((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, "success"));
      } else {
        message.error(
          t("models.testFailed", { error: result.error ?? "unknown" }),
        );
        setTestResults((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, "failure"));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      message.error(
        t("models.testFailed", {
          error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
        }),
      );
      setTestResults((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, "failure"));
    } finally {
      setTestingKey(null);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setTestResults((prev) => {
          const next = new Map(prev);
          next.delete(key);
          return next;
        });
      }, 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleReasoningChange = async (
    key: string,
    patch: { mode?: "auto" | "enabled" | "disabled"; effort?: string | null },
  ) => {
    const current = modelReasoning[key] || { mode: "auto" as const };
    try {
      await preferencesApi.patch({
        model_reasoning: {
          ...modelReasoning,
          [key]: { ...current, ...patch },
        },
      });
      await onSaved();
    } catch (err) {
      message.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : t("common.saveFailed"),
      );
    }
  };

  const renderReasoningPreference = (m: ResolvedModel, key: string) => {
    const capability = m.reasoning_config;
    if (!capability) return null;
    if (capability.adapter === "status_only") {
      return (
        <Tooltip title={t("chat.reasoningAlways", "始终推理")}>
          <Tag color="purple" style={{ marginInlineEnd: 0 }}>
            <Brain size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: -2 }} />
            {t("chat.reasoningAlways", "始终推理")}
          </Tag>
        </Tooltip>
      );
    }
    const preference = modelReasoning[key] || {
      mode: capability.default_mode,
      effort: capability.default_effort,
    };
    const content = (
      <div style={{ width: 250, display: "grid", gap: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {t("chat.reasoningMode", "思考模式")}
        </div>
        <Segmented
          block
          value={preference.mode}
          options={[
            { value: "auto", label: t("chat.reasoningAuto", "自动") },
            { value: "enabled", label: t("chat.reasoningEnabled", "开启") },
            ...(capability.toggle
              ? [
                  {
                    value: "disabled",
                    label: t("chat.reasoningDisabled", "关闭"),
                  },
                ]
              : []),
          ]}
          onChange={(value) =>
            void handleReasoningChange(key, {
              mode: value as "auto" | "enabled" | "disabled",
            })
          }
        />
        {capability.efforts.length > 0 && (
          <Select
            value={preference.effort || undefined}
            allowClear
            placeholder={t("chat.reasoningEffort", "思考强度")}
            options={capability.efforts.map((effort) => ({
              value: effort,
              label: effort,
            }))}
            onChange={(effort) =>
              void handleReasoningChange(key, { effort: effort || null })
            }
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
    return (
      <Popover trigger="click" placement="left" content={content}>
        <Tag color="purple" style={{ cursor: "pointer", marginInlineEnd: 0 }}>
          <Brain size={12} style={{ marginRight: 4, verticalAlign: -2 }} />
          {preference.effort ||
            (preference.mode === "enabled"
              ? t("chat.reasoningEnabled", "开启")
              : preference.mode === "disabled"
              ? t("chat.reasoningDisabled", "关闭")
              : t("chat.reasoningAuto", "自动"))}
        </Tag>
      </Popover>
    );
  };

  const renderCapabilityTags = (m: ResolvedModel) => (
    <ModelMetaTags
      includeText
      input={m.input}
      context_window={m.context_window}
      max_tokens={m.max_tokens}
      reasoning={m.reasoning}
      className={styles.poolModelTags}
    />
  );

  if (resolvedModels.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.poolSection}>
        <div className={styles.poolHeader}>
          <div className={styles.poolHeaderLeft}>
            <h3 className={styles.slotTitle}>{t("models.modelPool")}</h3>
            <Tooltip title={t("models.autoRouteTooltip")}>
              <Info size={14} className={styles.poolInfoIcon} />
            </Tooltip>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Empty
          image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
          description={t("models.noModelsAvailable")}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.poolSection}>
      <div className={styles.poolHeader}>
        <div className={styles.poolHeaderLeft}>
          <h3 className={styles.slotTitle}>{t("models.modelPool")}</h3>
          <Tooltip title={t("models.autoRouteTooltip")}>
            <Info size={14} className={styles.poolInfoIcon} />
          </Tooltip>
        </div>
        <Tag color="green" className={styles.poolCountTag}>
          {t("models.modelCount", { count: resolvedModels.length })}
        </Tag>
      </div>

      <p className={styles.poolDesc}>{t("models.autoRouteDesc")}</p>

      <div className={styles.poolList}>
        {grouped.map((group) => (
          <div key={group.providerName} className={styles.poolGroup}>
            <div className={styles.poolGroupHeader}>
              <div className={styles.poolGroupHeaderLeft}>
                <span className={styles.poolGroupName}>
                  {group.providerName}
                </span>
                <Tag className={styles.poolGroupKind}>{group.providerKind}</Tag>
              </div>
              <span className={styles.poolGroupCount}>
                {group.models.length} {t("models.modelUnit")}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.poolGroupModels}>
              {group.models.map((m) => {
                const key = `${m.provider_name}/${m.model}`;
                const isPreferred =
                  m.provider_name === activeModel.provider_name &&
                  m.model === activeModel.model;
                const isLoading = setting === key;
                const isTesting = testingKey === key;
                const canTest = providerHasKey.get(m.provider_id) ?? false;
                const capTags = renderCapabilityTags(m);
                const testState = testResults.get(key);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={key}
                    className={`${styles.poolModelRow} ${
                      isPreferred ? styles.poolModelPreferred : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Tooltip
                      title={
                        isPreferred
                          ? t("models.currentPreferred")
                          : t("models.setAsPreferred")
                      }
                    >
                      <Button
                        type="text"
                        size="small"
                        loading={isLoading}
                        className={`${styles.preferredBtn} ${
                          isPreferred ? styles.preferredActive : ""
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => void handleSetPreferred(m)}
                        icon={
                          <Star
                            size={14}
                            fill={isPreferred ? "currentColor" : "none"}
                          />
                        }
                      />
                    </Tooltip>

                    <div className={styles.poolModelInfo}>
                      <span
                        className={styles.poolModelName}
                        title={modelOptionLabel(m)}
                      >
                        {modelOptionLabel(m)}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {capTags}
                    {renderReasoningPreference(m, key)}

                    {canTest && (
                      <div className={styles.poolModelActions}>
                        {isTesting ? (
                          <Button type="text" size="small" loading />
                        ) : testState === "success" ? (
                          <Check size={14} style={{ color: "#52c41a" }} />
                        ) : testState === "failure" ? (
                          <X size={14} style={{ color: "#ff4d4f" }} />
                        ) : (
                          <Tooltip title={t("models.testConnection")}>
                            <Button
                              type="text"
                              size="small"
                              icon={<Zap size={14} />}
                              onClick={() => void handleTestModel(m)}
                            />
                          </Tooltip>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * LoadingState — finnie-equivalent loading/error pane.
 *
 * Identical to finnie's
 * ``dashboard/src/pages/Settings/Models/components/sections/LoadingState.tsx``
 * except labels are translated via i18n.
 */
import { Button } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import styles from "../../index.module.less";

interface LoadingStateProps {
  message: string;
  error?: boolean;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export function LoadingState({
  message,
  error,
  onRetry,
  className,
}: LoadingStateProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.loading} ${className || ""}`}>
      <span
        className={styles.loadingText}
        style={{ color: error ? "var(--fn-color-danger)" : undefined }}
      >
        {message}
      </span>
      {error && onRetry && (
        <Button onClick={onRetry} style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          {t("models.retry")}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: dashboard/src/pages/Settings/Models/components/CodexOAuthConnect.tsx
````typescript
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Alert, Button, Space, Spin, Typography } from "antd";
import { message } from "@/utils/antdMessage";

import { ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { pollCodexOAuth, startCodexOAuth } from "../providerApi";

interface CodexOAuthConnectProps {
  onSuccess: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 3000;

export function CodexOAuthConnect({ onSuccess }: CodexOAuthConnectProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [device, setDevice] = useState<{
    stateId: string;
    userCode: string;
    verificationUrl: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const pollRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const stopPolling = useCallback(() => {
    if (pollRef.current !== null) {
      clearInterval(pollRef.current);
      pollRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => stopPolling, [stopPolling]);

  const handleLogin = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { state_id, user_code, verification_url } = await startCodexOAuth();
      setDevice({
        stateId: state_id,
        userCode: user_code,
        verificationUrl: verification_url,
      });
      window.open(verification_url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");

      pollRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const pending = await pollCodexOAuth(state_id);
          if (pending.status === "ok") {
            stopPolling();
            setDevice(null);
            setLoading(false);
            message.success(t("models.codexOAuthSuccess"));
            await onSuccess();
          } else if (pending.status === "error") {
            stopPolling();
            setDevice(null);
            setLoading(false);
            message.error(
              t("models.codexOAuthFailed", {
                error: pending.error ?? "unknown",
              }),
            );
          }
        } catch {
          stopPolling();
          setDevice(null);
          setLoading(false);
          message.error(t("models.codexOAuthFailed", { error: "poll" }));
        }
      }, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
    } catch (err) {
      message.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : t("models.codexOAuthStartFailed"),
      );
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [onSuccess, stopPolling, t]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    stopPolling();
    setDevice(null);
    setLoading(false);
  }, [stopPolling]);

  return (
    <Space direction="vertical" size="middle" style={{ width: "100%" }}>
      <Alert
        type="warning"
        showIcon
        message={t("models.codexOAuthDisclaimer")}
      />
      <Typography.Paragraph type="secondary" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
        {t("models.codexOAuthHint")}
      </Typography.Paragraph>

      {device ? (
        <Space direction="vertical" size="middle" style={{ width: "100%" }}>
          <Typography.Paragraph style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
            {t("models.codexOAuthDeviceHint")}
          </Typography.Paragraph>
          <Typography.Text
            copyable={{ text: device.userCode }}
            style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 4 }}
          >
            {device.userCode}
          </Typography.Text>
          <Space>
            <Button
              icon={<ExternalLink size={14} />}
              onClick={() =>
                window.open(
                  device.verificationUrl,
                  "_blank",
                  "noopener,noreferrer",
                )
              }
            >
              {t("models.codexOAuthOpenVerification")}
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleCancel}>{t("common.cancel")}</Button>
          </Space>
          <Space>
            <Spin size="small" />
            <Typography.Text type="secondary">
              {t("models.codexOAuthWaiting")}
            </Typography.Text>
          </Space>
        </Space>
      ) : (
        <Button
          type="primary"
          loading={loading}
          onClick={() => void handleLogin()}
        >
          {t("models.codexOAuthLogin")}
        </Button>
      )}
    </Space>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  App,
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  Collapse,
  Drawer,
  Form,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  Radio,
  Slider,
  Switch,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import { Activity, Settings2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  decisionApi,
  type DecisionProvider,
  type DecisionSettings,
  type LayaStatus,
} from "../../../../api/modules/decision";
import customProviderLogo from "../../../../assets/providers/custom-provider.svg";
import jevLogo from "../../../../assets/providers/jev.png";
import layaLogo from "../../../../assets/providers/laya.png";
import microsoftLogo from "../../../../assets/providers/microsoft.png";
import { apiErrorMessage } from "../../../../utils/apiError";
import styles from "./DecisionSettingsPanel.module.less";
import { LayaLocalInstall } from "./LayaLocalInstall";

const { Paragraph, Text } = Typography;

const OPENROUTER_DECISIONS = "https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions";
const JEV_MODEL = "typesafe/jev-1.13";
const MICROSOFT_MODEL = "microsoft/microsoft-decision-1";
const LAYA_ENDPOINT = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/systemone";
const LAYA_AUTO = "auto";

type PresetId = "jev" | "microsoft" | "laya" | "custom";

const PRESETS: PresetId[] = ["jev", "microsoft", "laya", "custom"];

const JEV_MODELS = [JEV_MODEL, "~typesafe/jev-latest"];
const MICROSOFT_MODELS = [MICROSOFT_MODEL];

function inferPreset(settings: DecisionSettings): PresetId {
  if (
    settings.provider === "custom" ||
    settings.provider === "microsoft" ||
    settings.provider === "laya" ||
    settings.provider === "jev"
  ) {
    return settings.provider;
  }
  return "jev";
}

interface ServiceDraft {
  endpoint: string;
  model: string;
  apiKey: string;
  apiKeySet: boolean;
  filledSavedKey: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
}

function blankDraft(): ServiceDraft {
  return {
    endpoint: "",
    model: "",
    apiKey: "",
    apiKeySet: false,
    filledSavedKey: false,
    edited: false,
  };
}

function savedEndpointsFrom(
  settings: DecisionSettings,
): Record<PresetId, string> {
  const endpoints = { jev: "", microsoft: "", laya: "", custom: "" };
  for (const id of PRESETS) {
    const saved = settings.services?.find((item) => item.provider === id);
    endpoints[id] =
      saved?.endpoint ?? (settings.provider === id ? settings.endpoint : "");
  }
  return endpoints;
}

function draftsFrom(
  settings: DecisionSettings,
): Record<PresetId, ServiceDraft> {
  const drafts = {
    jev: blankDraft(),
    microsoft: blankDraft(),
    laya: blankDraft(),
    custom: blankDraft(),
  };
  for (const id of PRESETS) {
    const saved = settings.services?.find((item) => item.provider === id);
    const selected = settings.provider === id;
    const endpoint = saved?.endpoint ?? (selected ? settings.endpoint : "");
    const model = saved?.model ?? (selected ? settings.model : "");
    drafts[id] = {
      endpoint,
      model: id === "laya" && endpoint && !model ? LAYA_AUTO : model,
      apiKey: "",
      apiKeySet:
        saved?.api_key_set ?? (selected ? settings.api_key_set : false),
      filledSavedKey: false,
      edited: false,
    };
  }
  const selected = inferPreset(settings);
  if (!drafts[selected].endpoint && !drafts[selected].model) {
    drafts[selected] = {
      ...drafts[selected],
      endpoint: defaultEndpoint(selected),
      model: defaultModel(selected),
    };
  }
  return drafts;
}

function defaultEndpoint(preset: PresetId): string {
  if (preset === "laya") return LAYA_ENDPOINT;
  if (preset === "custom") return "";
  return OPENROUTER_DECISIONS;
}

function defaultModel(preset: PresetId): string {
  if (preset === "jev") return JEV_MODEL;
  if (preset === "microsoft") return MICROSOFT_MODEL;
  if (preset === "laya") return LAYA_AUTO;
  return "";
}

function wireModel(preset: PresetId, model: string): string {
  const trimmed = model.trim();
  if (preset === "laya" && (trimmed === "" || trimmed === LAYA_AUTO)) return "";
  return trimmed;
}

function connectionFor(
  preset: PresetId,
  endpoint: string,
  model: string,
): { provider: DecisionProvider; endpoint: string; model: string } {
  const provider: DecisionProvider =
    preset === "microsoft"
      ? "microsoft"
      : preset === "laya"
      ? "laya"
      : preset === "custom"
      ? "custom"
      : "jev";
  return {
    provider,
    endpoint: endpoint.trim(),
    model: wireModel(preset, model),
  };
}

function DrawerFields({
  preset,
  endpoint,
  model,
  apiKey,
  apiKeySet,
  filledSavedKey,
  openRouterKey,
  onEndpoint,
  onModel,
  onApiKey,
  onUseSavedKey,
  layaActive,
  onLayaStatus,
}: {
  preset: PresetId;
  endpoint: string;
  model: string;
  apiKey: string;
  apiKeySet: boolean;
  filledSavedKey: boolean;
  openRouterKey?: string | null;
  onEndpoint: (value: string) => void;
  onModel: (value: string) => void;
  onApiKey: (value: string) => void;
  onUseSavedKey: () => void;
  layaActive: boolean;
  onLayaStatus: (status: LayaStatus) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const cloud = preset === "jev" || preset === "microsoft";
  const modelRequired = cloud;
  const keyRequired =
    endpoint.includes("openrouter.ai") && !apiKeySet && !filledSavedKey;
  const label = (text: string, required: boolean) => (
    <span>
      {text}
      {required ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <span className={styles.requiredMark}>*</span>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
  const layaModels = [
    { value: LAYA_AUTO, label: t("models.decisionLayaModelAuto") },
    { value: "multilingual", label: t("models.decisionLayaModelMulti") },
    { value: "english", label: t("models.decisionLayaModelEn") },
    { value: "typed-decisions", label: t("models.decisionLayaModelTyped") },
  ];
  const modelOptions =
    preset === "laya"
      ? layaModels
      : (preset === "microsoft" ? MICROSOFT_MODELS : JEV_MODELS).map(
          (value) => ({ value, label: value }),
        );
  const showSavedKey =
    cloud && Boolean(openRouterKey) && endpoint.includes("openrouter.ai");
  return (
    <div className={styles.drawerBody}>
      <div className={styles.drawerHint}>
        {t(
          preset === "jev"
            ? "models.decisionJevDetail"
            : preset === "microsoft"
            ? "models.decisionMsDetail"
            : preset === "laya"
            ? "models.decisionLayaDetail"
            : "models.decisionCustomDetail",
        )}
      </div>
      {preset === "laya" ? (
        <LayaLocalInstall
          active={layaActive}
          onStatusChange={onLayaStatus}
          onReady={() => {
            onEndpoint(LAYA_ENDPOINT);
            onModel(LAYA_AUTO);
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
      <div className={styles.configSectionTitle}>
        {t("models.decisionConnection")}
      </div>
      <Form
        className={styles.drawerForm}
        layout="vertical"
        requiredMark={false}
      >
        <Form.Item label={label(t("models.decisionEndpoint"), true)}>
          <Input
            value={endpoint}
            placeholder={defaultEndpoint(preset) || OPENROUTER_DECISIONS}
            spellCheck={false}
            onChange={(event) => onEndpoint(event.target.value)}
          />
        </Form.Item>
        <Form.Item
          label={label(t("models.decisionModel"), modelRequired)}
          extra={
            preset === "laya"
              ? undefined
              : preset === "custom"
              ? t("models.decisionCustomModelHint")
              : t("models.decisionModelPick")
          }
        >
          {preset === "laya" ? (
            <>
              <Radio.Group
                className={styles.modelChoices}
                value={model || LAYA_AUTO}
                onChange={(event) => onModel(event.target.value)}
              >
                {layaModels.map((item) => (
                  <Radio key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                    {item.label}
                  </Radio>
                ))}
              </Radio.Group>
              <p className={styles.modelHint}>
                {t("models.decisionModelOptional")}
              </p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <AutoComplete
              value={model}
              options={preset === "custom" ? [] : modelOptions}
              filterOption={(input, option) => {
                const haystack = `${option?.value ?? ""} ${
                  option?.label ?? ""
                }`;
                return haystack
                  .toLowerCase()
                  .includes(input.trim().toLowerCase());
              }}
              onChange={onModel}
            >
              <Input
                spellCheck={false}
                placeholder={defaultModel(preset) || JEV_MODEL}
              />
            </AutoComplete>
          )}
        </Form.Item>
        <Form.Item
          label={label(t("models.decisionApiKey"), keyRequired)}
          extra={
            filledSavedKey
              ? t("models.decisionSavedKeyReady")
              : apiKeySet
              ? t("models.decisionApiKeyKeep")
              : preset === "laya"
              ? t("models.decisionLayaKeyHint")
              : t("models.decisionApiKeyHint")
          }
        >
          <Input.Password
            value={apiKey}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            onChange={(event) => onApiKey(event.target.value)}
          />
        </Form.Item>
        {showSavedKey || endpoint.includes("openrouter.ai") ? (
          <div className={styles.guideLinks}>
            {showSavedKey ? (
              <Button type="link" size="small" onClick={onUseSavedKey}>
                {t("models.decisionUseSavedKey")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
            {endpoint.includes("openrouter.ai") ? (
              <a
                href="https://openrouter.ai/keys"
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
              >
                {t("models.decisionCreateKey")}
              </a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </Form>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DecisionSettingsPanel({
  openRouterKey,
}: {
  openRouterKey?: string | null;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const [form] = Form.useForm();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [testingId, setTestingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preset, setPreset] = useState<PresetId>("jev");
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<Record<PresetId, ServiceDraft>>(() =>
    draftsFrom({
      enabled: false,
      provider: "jev",
      endpoint: "",
      model: "",
      skills: true,
      tools: false,
      team: true,
      threshold: 0.6,
      tool_min_count: 8,
      api_key_set: false,
      active: false,
    }),
  );
  const [savedProvider, setSavedProvider] = useState<PresetId>("jev");
  const [savedEndpoints, setSavedEndpoints] = useState<
    Record<PresetId, string>
  >({ jev: "", microsoft: "", laya: "", custom: "" });
  const [savedActive, setSavedActive] = useState(false);
  const [layaReady, setLayaReady] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<PresetId | null>(null);
  const enabled = Form.useWatch("enabled", form);
  const skills = Form.useWatch("skills", form);
  const tools = Form.useWatch("tools", form);
  const team = Form.useWatch("team", form);

  const applySaved = (saved: DecisionSettings) => {
    const next = inferPreset(saved);
    setPreset(next);
    setSavedProvider(next);
    setSavedEndpoints(savedEndpointsFrom(saved));
    setSavedActive(saved.active);
    setDrafts(draftsFrom(saved));
    form.setFieldsValue({ ...saved, provider: next, api_key: "" });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    void decisionApi
      .get()
      .then((settings) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        applySaved(settings);
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        if (!cancelled)
          message.error(
            apiErrorMessage(error, t("models.decisionLoadFailed"), t),
          );
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // applySaved closes over the form instance, which is stable.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [form, message, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void decisionApi
      .layaStatus()
      .then((status) => setLayaReady(status.running))
      .catch(() => setLayaReady(false));
  }, []);

  const patchDraft = (id: PresetId, patch: Partial<ServiceDraft>) => {
    setDrafts((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [id]: { ...current[id], ...patch },
    }));
  };

  const selectProvider = (id: PresetId) => {
    setPreset(id);
    form.setFieldValue("provider", id);
    setDrafts((current) => {
      const draft = current[id];
      if (draft.endpoint || draft.model) return current;
      return {
        ...current,
        [id]: {
          ...draft,
          endpoint: defaultEndpoint(id),
          model: defaultModel(id),
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const openEditor = (id: PresetId) => {
    setEditing(id);
    setDrafts((current) => {
      const draft = current[id];
      if (draft.endpoint || draft.model) return current;
      return {
        ...current,
        [id]: {
          ...draft,
          endpoint: defaultEndpoint(id),
          model: defaultModel(id),
        },
      };
    });
  };

  const persist = async (forceId?: PresetId) => {
    const values = form.getFieldsValue(true);
    const selected = connectionFor(
      preset,
      drafts[preset].endpoint,
      drafts[preset].model,
    );
    if (values.enabled && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(selected.endpoint)) {
      message.error(t("models.decisionNeedEndpoint"));
      return false;
    }
    if (
      values.enabled &&
      (preset === "jev" || preset === "microsoft") &&
      !selected.model
    ) {
      message.error(t("models.decisionNeedModel"));
      return false;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const saved = await decisionApi.save({
        enabled: Boolean(values.enabled),
        provider: selected.provider,
        endpoint: selected.endpoint,
        model: selected.model,
        skills: Boolean(values.skills),
        tools: Boolean(values.tools),
        team: Boolean(values.team),
        threshold: Number(values.threshold),
        tool_min_count: Number(values.tool_min_count),
        services: PRESETS.map((id) => {
          const keep =
            id === preset ||
            id === forceId ||
            Boolean(savedEndpoints[id]) ||
            drafts[id].edited;
          const connection = keep
            ? connectionFor(id, drafts[id].endpoint, drafts[id].model)
            : { provider: id, endpoint: "", model: "" };
          return {
            provider: id,
            endpoint: connection.endpoint,
            model: connection.model,
            api_key: keep && drafts[id].apiKey ? drafts[id].apiKey : null,
          };
        }),
      });
      applySaved(saved);
      message.success(t("models.decisionSaved"));
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      message.error(apiErrorMessage(error, t("common.saveFailed"), t));
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const saveEditor = async () => {
    if (!editing) return;
    const connection = connectionFor(
      editing,
      drafts[editing].endpoint,
      drafts[editing].model,
    );
    if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(connection.endpoint)) {
      message.error(t("models.decisionNeedEndpoint"));
      return;
    }
    if ((editing === "jev" || editing === "microsoft") && !connection.model) {
      message.error(t("models.decisionNeedModel"));
      return;
    }
    if (await persist(editing)) setEditing(null);
  };

  const runTest = async (id: PresetId) => {
    const connection = connectionFor(id, drafts[id].endpoint, drafts[id].model);
    if (!connection.endpoint.trim()) {
      message.error(t("models.decisionNeedEndpoint"));
      return;
    }
    setTestingId(id);
    try {
      const result = await decisionApi.test({
        endpoint: connection.endpoint,
        model: connection.model,
        provider: connection.provider,
        api_key: drafts[id].apiKey || undefined,
      });
      if (result.ok) {
        message.success(
          t("models.decisionTestOk", {
            probability: Number(result.probability).toFixed(2),
          }),
        );
      } else {
        message.error(result.error || t("models.decisionTestFailed"));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      message.error(apiErrorMessage(error, t("models.decisionTestFailed"), t));
    } finally {
      setTestingId(null);
    }
  };

  const presetLogos: Record<PresetId, { src: string; mark: boolean }> = {
    jev: { src: jevLogo, mark: true },
    microsoft: { src: microsoftLogo, mark: false },
    laya: { src: layaLogo, mark: false },
    custom: { src: customProviderLogo, mark: false },
  };

  const choiceCopy: Record<
    PresetId,
    { name: string; host: string; blurb: string; hostTone: string }
  > = {
    jev: {
      name: t("models.decisionJevName"),
      host: t("models.decisionJevHost"),
      blurb: t("models.decisionJevBlurb"),
      hostTone: styles.hostCloud,
    },
    microsoft: {
      name: t("models.decisionMsName"),
      host: t("models.decisionMsHost"),
      blurb: t("models.decisionMsBlurb"),
      hostTone: styles.hostCloud,
    },
    laya: {
      name: t("models.decisionLayaName"),
      host: t("models.decisionLayaHost"),
      blurb: t("models.decisionLayaBlurb"),
      hostTone: styles.hostLocal,
    },
    custom: {
      name: t("models.decisionCustomName"),
      host: t("models.decisionCustomHost"),
      blurb: t("models.decisionCustomBlurb"),
      hostTone: styles.hostOwn,
    },
  };

  const taskChecked = { skills, tools, team } as const;

  return (
    <>
      <Form
        className={styles.panel}
        form={form}
        layout="vertical"
        disabled={loading}
        initialValues={{
          enabled: false,
          provider: "jev",
          endpoint: OPENROUTER_DECISIONS,
          model: JEV_MODEL,
          skills: true,
          tools: false,
          team: true,
          threshold: 0.6,
          tool_min_count: 8,
        }}
      >
        <p className={styles.intro}>{t("models.decisionIntro")}</p>
        <div className={styles.enableRow}>
          <Form.Item name="enabled" valuePropName="checked" noStyle>
            <Switch />
          </Form.Item>
          <span className={styles.enableLabel}>
            {t("models.decisionEnabled")}
          </span>
        </div>
        {enabled ? (
          <>
            <div className={styles.sectionLabel}>
              {t("models.decisionPick")}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.choices}>
              {PRESETS.map((id) => {
                const copy = choiceCopy[id];
                const configured = Boolean(savedEndpoints[id]);
                const selected = preset === id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={id}
                    className={`${styles.choice} ${
                      selected ? styles.choiceOn : ""
                    }`}
                    aria-pressed={selected}
                    onClick={() => selectProvider(id)}
                  >
                    <span className={styles.choiceTop}>
                      <span className={styles.logoTile}>
                        <img
                          className={`${styles.logo} ${
                            presetLogos[id].mark ? styles.logoMark : ""
                          }`}
                          src={presetLogos[id].src}
                          alt=""
                        />
                      </span>
                      <span className={styles.titleBlock}>
                        <span className={styles.choiceName}>{copy.name}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className={styles.badgeRow}>
                        <span className={styles.badgePair}>
                          <span
                            className={`${styles.hostFlag} ${copy.hostTone}`}
                          >
                            {copy.host}
                          </span>
                          {id === "laya" && layaReady ? (
                            <span
                              className={`${styles.hostFlag} ${styles.serviceReady}`}
                            >
                              {t("models.decisionServiceReady")}
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                        </span>
                        {configured && !selected ? (
                          <span
                            className={`${styles.hostFlag} ${styles.serviceConfigured}`}
                          >
                            {t("models.decisionConfiguredInactive")}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className={styles.choiceBlurb}>{copy.blurb}</span>
                    <span className={styles.actions}>
                      {drafts[id].endpoint ? (
                        <Button
                          type="text"
                          size="small"
                          className={styles.iconBtn}
                          aria-label={t("models.decisionTest")}
                          title={t("models.decisionTest")}
                          icon={<Activity size={15} />}
                          loading={testingId === id}
                          onClick={(event) => {
                            event.stopPropagation();
                            void runTest(id);
                          }}
                        />
                      ) : null}
                      <Button
                        size="small"
                        type={configured ? "default" : "primary"}
                        icon={<Settings2 size={14} />}
                        onClick={(event) => {
                          event.stopPropagation();
                          openEditor(id);
                        }}
                      >
                        {configured
                          ? t("common.edit")
                          : t("advancedSettings.search.configure")}
                      </Button>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className={styles.sectionLabel}>
              {t("models.decisionScope")}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.tasks}>
              {(
                [
                  [
                    "skills",
                    "models.decisionSkills",
                    "models.decisionSkillsDesc",
                  ],
                  ["tools", "models.decisionTools", "models.decisionToolsDesc"],
                  ["team", "models.decisionTeam", "models.decisionTeamDesc"],
                ] as const
              ).map(([name, titleKey, descKey]) => {
                const checked = Boolean(taskChecked[name]);
                return (
                  <div
                    key={name}
                    className={`${styles.task} ${checked ? styles.taskOn : ""}`}
                    role="checkbox"
                    aria-checked={checked}
                    onClick={() => form.setFieldValue(name, !checked)}
                  >
                    <span className={styles.taskHead}>
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={checked}
                        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          form.setFieldValue(name, event.target.checked)
                        }
                      />
                      <span className={styles.taskTitle}>{t(titleKey)}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className={styles.taskDesc}>{t(descKey)}</span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <Form.Item name="skills" valuePropName="checked" hidden>
              <Switch />
            </Form.Item>
            <Form.Item name="tools" valuePropName="checked" hidden>
              <Switch />
            </Form.Item>
            <Form.Item name="team" valuePropName="checked" hidden>
              <Switch />
            </Form.Item>

            <Collapse
              className={styles.more}
              ghost
              items={[
                {
                  key: "more",
                  label: t("models.decisionMore"),
                  children: (
                    <>
                      <Form.Item
                        name="threshold"
                        label={t("models.decisionThreshold")}
                        extra={t("models.decisionThresholdHint")}
                      >
                        <Slider
                          min={0.05}
                          max={0.95}
                          step={0.05}
                          marks={{
                            0.4: t("models.decisionLoose"),
                            0.6: t("models.decisionBalanced"),
                            0.8: t("models.decisionStrict"),
                          }}
                        />
                      </Form.Item>
                      <Form.Item
                        name="tool_min_count"
                        label={t("models.decisionToolMin")}
                        extra={t("models.decisionToolMinHint")}
                      >
                        <InputNumber min={1} max={100} step={1} />
                      </Form.Item>
                    </>
                  ),
                },
              ]}
            />
          </>
        ) : null}

        <div className={styles.footer}>
          <Button
            type="primary"
            loading={saving}
            onClick={() => void persist()}
          >
            {t("common.save")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <Paragraph className={styles.fallback}>
          <Text type="secondary">
            {enabled
              ? t("models.decisionFallback")
              : t("models.decisionOffHint")}
          </Text>
        </Paragraph>
      </Form>
      <Drawer
        title={editing ? choiceCopy[editing].name : ""}
        open={editing !== null}
        onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
        width={440}
        placement="right"
        destroyOnHidden
        footer={
          <div className={styles.drawerFooter}>
            <Button onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>
              {t("common.cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              icon={<Activity size={14} />}
              loading={editing !== null && testingId === editing}
              onClick={() => {
                if (editing) void runTest(editing);
              }}
            >
              {t("models.decisionTest")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="primary"
              loading={saving}
              onClick={() => void saveEditor()}
            >
              {t("common.save")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      >
        {editing ? (
          <DrawerFields
            preset={editing}
            endpoint={drafts[editing].endpoint}
            model={drafts[editing].model}
            apiKey={drafts[editing].apiKey}
            apiKeySet={drafts[editing].apiKeySet && !drafts[editing].apiKey}
            filledSavedKey={drafts[editing].filledSavedKey}
            openRouterKey={openRouterKey}
            layaActive={savedActive && savedProvider === "laya"}
            onLayaStatus={(status) => setLayaReady(status.running)}
            onEndpoint={(value) =>
              patchDraft(editing, { endpoint: value, edited: true })
            }
            onModel={(value) =>
              patchDraft(editing, { model: value, edited: true })
            }
            onApiKey={(value) =>
              patchDraft(editing, { apiKey: value, edited: true })
            }
            onUseSavedKey={() => {
              if (!openRouterKey) return;
              patchDraft(editing, {
                apiKey: openRouterKey,
                filledSavedKey: true,
                edited: true,
              });
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * EmbeddingModelPool — list all enabled embedding models (no preferred/default).
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Check, Info, X, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { Button, Empty, Space, Tag, Tooltip } from "antd";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { message } from "@/utils/antdMessage";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { request } from "../../../../api/request";
import type { ProviderModel, ProviderRow } from "../useProviders";
import { isEmbeddingModel } from "../useProviders";
import { isOnnxProviderRow } from "../presetUtils";
import styles from "../index.module.less";

interface EmbeddingModelPoolProps {
  providers: ProviderRow[];
  /** Brief highlight after a provider/model save. */
  flash?: boolean;
  showServicesCta?: boolean;
  onScrollToServices?: () => void;
}

interface PoolEntry {
  providerId: number;
  providerName: string;
  providerKind: string;
  model: ProviderModel;
}

interface Grouped {
  providerId: number;
  providerName: string;
  providerKind: string;
  models: ProviderModel[];
}

export function EmbeddingModelPool({
  providers,
  flash = false,
  showServicesCta = false,
  onScrollToServices,
}: EmbeddingModelPoolProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [testingKey, setTestingKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState<
    Map<string, "success" | "failure">
  >(new Map());

  const entries = useMemo(() => {
    const out: PoolEntry[] = [];
    for (const provider of providers) {
      if (!provider.enabled || !provider.api_key) continue;
      const onnx = isOnnxProviderRow(provider);
      const embeddingLane = onnx || provider.purpose === "embedding";
      for (const model of provider.models ?? []) {
        if (model.enabled === false) continue;
        if (!embeddingLane && !isEmbeddingModel(model)) continue;
        out.push({
          providerId: provider.id,
          providerName: provider.name,
          providerKind: provider.kind,
          model,
        });
      }
    }
    return out;
  }, [providers]);

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Grouped>();
    for (const entry of entries) {
      let group = map.get(entry.providerName);
      if (!group) {
        group = {
          providerId: entry.providerId,
          providerName: entry.providerName,
          providerKind: entry.providerKind,
          models: [],
        };
        map.set(entry.providerName, group);
      }
      group.models.push(entry.model);
    }
    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [entries]);

  const handleTest = async (entry: PoolEntry) => {
    const key = `${entry.providerName}/${entry.model.id}`;
    setTestingKey(key);
    try {
      const result = await request<{
        ok: boolean;
        latency_ms?: number;
        error?: string;
      }>(`/admin/providers/${entry.providerId}/test`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ model_id: entry.model.id, embedding: true }),
      });
      if (result.ok) {
        message.success(
          t("models.testSuccess", {
            name: entry.model.name || entry.model.id,
            time: result.latency_ms ?? 0,
          }),
        );
        setTestResults((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, "success"));
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          setTestResults((prev) => {
            const next = new Map(prev);
            next.delete(key);
            return next;
          });
        }, 2500);
      } else {
        message.error(
          t("models.testFailed", { error: result.error ?? "unknown" }),
        );
        setTestResults((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, "failure"));
        // Keep failure icon until the next test attempt.
      }
    } catch (err) {
      message.error(
        t("models.testFailed", {
          error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
        }),
      );
      setTestResults((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, "failure"));
    } finally {
      setTestingKey(null);
    }
  };

  const sectionClass = flash
    ? `${styles.poolSection} ${styles.poolSectionFlash}`
    : styles.poolSection;

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={sectionClass}>
        <div className={styles.poolHeader}>
          <div className={styles.poolHeaderLeft}>
            <h3 className={styles.slotTitle}>
              {t("models.embeddingModelPool")}
            </h3>
            <Tooltip title={t("models.embeddingModelPoolTooltip")}>
              <Info size={14} className={styles.poolInfoIcon} />
            </Tooltip>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Empty
          image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
          description={
            <div className={styles.poolEmptyBody}>
              <p className={styles.poolEmptyText}>
                {t("models.embeddingModelPoolEmpty")}
              </p>
              {showServicesCta ? (
                <Space wrap className={styles.poolEmptyActions}>
                  <Button type="primary" onClick={onScrollToServices}>
                    {t("models.embeddingPoolCtaServices")}
                  </Button>
                </Space>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          }
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={sectionClass}>
      <div className={styles.poolHeader}>
        <div className={styles.poolHeaderLeft}>
          <h3 className={styles.slotTitle}>{t("models.embeddingModelPool")}</h3>
          <Tooltip title={t("models.embeddingModelPoolTooltip")}>
            <Info size={14} className={styles.poolInfoIcon} />
          </Tooltip>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.poolHeaderRight}>
          <Link to="/knowledge-bases" className={styles.poolHeaderLink}>
            {t("models.embeddingPoolKnowledgeLink")}
          </Link>
          <Tag color="green" className={styles.poolCountTag}>
            {t("models.modelCount", { count: entries.length })}
          </Tag>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className={styles.poolDesc}>{t("models.embeddingModelPoolDesc")}</p>
      <div className={styles.poolList}>
        {grouped.map((group) => (
          <div key={group.providerName} className={styles.poolGroup}>
            <div className={styles.poolGroupHeader}>
              <div className={styles.poolGroupHeaderLeft}>
                <span className={styles.poolGroupName}>
                  {group.providerName}
                </span>
                <Tag className={styles.poolGroupKind}>{group.providerKind}</Tag>
              </div>
              <span className={styles.poolGroupCount}>
                {group.models.length} {t("models.modelUnit")}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.poolGroupModels}>
              {group.models.map((model) => {
                const key = `${group.providerName}/${model.id}`;
                const isTesting = testingKey === key;
                const testState = testResults.get(key);
                return (
                  <div key={key} className={styles.poolModelRow}>
                    <div className={styles.poolModelInfo}>
                      <span
                        className={styles.poolModelName}
                        title={model.name || model.id}
                      >
                        {model.name || model.id}
                      </span>
                      {model.id !== model.name && model.name ? (
                        <span className={styles.poolModelId}>{model.id}</span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <div className={styles.poolModelActions}>
                      {isTesting ? (
                        <Button type="text" size="small" loading />
                      ) : testState === "success" ? (
                        <Tooltip title={t("models.testConnection")}>
                          <Check size={14} style={{ color: "#52c41a" }} />
                        </Tooltip>
                      ) : testState === "failure" ? (
                        <Tooltip title={t("models.embeddingPoolRetest")}>
                          <Button
                            type="text"
                            size="small"
                            danger
                            icon={<X size={14} />}
                            onClick={() =>
                              void handleTest({
                                providerId: group.providerId,
                                providerName: group.providerName,
                                providerKind: group.providerKind,
                                model,
                              })
                            }
                          />
                        </Tooltip>
                      ) : (
                        <Tooltip title={t("models.testConnection")}>
                          <Button
                            type="text"
                            size="small"
                            icon={<Zap size={14} />}
                            onClick={() =>
                              void handleTest({
                                providerId: group.providerId,
                                providerName: group.providerName,
                                providerKind: group.providerKind,
                                model,
                              })
                            }
                          />
                        </Tooltip>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * EmbeddingSettingsPanel — manage embedding-only providers + ONNX.
 *
 * Logical split from the chat Models tab (scheme A): same providers table,
 * but ``purpose=embedding`` / ONNX rows are added and edited here.
 * Spacing / card grid mirror the chat Models tab.
 */
import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Divider, Typography } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { ProviderPreset, ProviderRow } from "../useProviders";
import { isEmbeddingProvider } from "../useProviders";
import { findConfiguredProvider, isOnnxProviderRow } from "../presetUtils";
import { AddProviderCard } from "./cards/AddProviderCard";
import { LocalServiceCard } from "./cards/LocalServiceCard";
import { PresetProviderCard } from "./cards/PresetProviderCard";
import { ProviderCard } from "./cards/ProviderCard";
import { CustomProviderModal } from "./modals/CustomProviderModal";
import { EmbeddingModelPool } from "./EmbeddingModelPool";
import pageStyles from "../index.module.less";
import styles from "./EmbeddingSettingsPanel.module.less";

const { Paragraph, Title } = Typography;

interface EmbeddingSettingsPanelProps {
  providers: ProviderRow[];
  presets: ProviderPreset[];
  canProviders: boolean;
  canOnnx: boolean;
  onSaved: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

function isEmbeddingPreset(preset: ProviderPreset): boolean {
  return (
    preset.purpose === "embedding" || preset.provider_variant === "embedding"
  );
}

export function EmbeddingSettingsPanel({
  providers,
  presets,
  canProviders,
  canOnnx,
  onSaved,
}: EmbeddingSettingsPanelProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false);
  const [hoveredCard, setHoveredCard] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [poolFlash, setPoolFlash] = useState(false);
  const servicesRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const flashTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const handleSaved = useCallback(async () => {
    await onSaved();
    setPoolFlash(true);
    if (flashTimer.current != null) window.clearTimeout(flashTimer.current);
    flashTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setPoolFlash(false);
      flashTimer.current = null;
    }, 1600);
  }, [onSaved]);

  const scrollToServices = useCallback(() => {
    servicesRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }, []);

  const onnxPreset = useMemo(
    () => presets.find((preset) => preset.id === "onnx") ?? null,
    [presets],
  );
  const onnxProvider = useMemo(() => {
    if (!onnxPreset) return null;
    return findConfiguredProvider(onnxPreset, providers) ?? null;
  }, [onnxPreset, providers]);

  const cloudEmbeddingPresets = useMemo(
    () =>
      presets.filter(
        (preset) => isEmbeddingPreset(preset) && preset.id !== "onnx",
      ),
    [presets],
  );

  /** Custom embedding providers not covered by a cloud preset card. */
  const customEmbeddingProviders = useMemo(() => {
    const presetKeys = new Set(
      cloudEmbeddingPresets.flatMap((preset) => [
        preset.id,
        preset.name,
        preset.name.toLowerCase(),
      ]),
    );
    return providers
      .filter(
        (provider) =>
          isEmbeddingProvider(provider) &&
          !isOnnxProviderRow(provider) &&
          !presetKeys.has(provider.name) &&
          !presetKeys.has(provider.name.toLowerCase()),
      )
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.enabled !== b.enabled) return a.enabled ? -1 : 1;
        return a.id - b.id;
      });
  }, [providers, cloudEmbeddingPresets]);

  const showLocal = canOnnx && !!onnxPreset;
  const showCloud = canProviders;
  const showServices = showLocal || showCloud;

  return (
    <div className={styles.panel}>
      <Paragraph className={styles.intro}>
        {t("models.embeddingIntro")}
      </Paragraph>

      <EmbeddingModelPool
        providers={providers}
        flash={poolFlash}
        showServicesCta={showServices}
        onScrollToServices={scrollToServices}
      />

      {showServices ? (
        <>
          <Divider style={{ margin: "24px 0" }} />
          <div ref={servicesRef} className={styles.section}>
            <Title level={5} className={styles.sectionTitle}>
              {t("models.embeddingServicesSection")}
            </Title>
            <div
              className={`${pageStyles.providerCards} ${pageStyles.serviceCardsArea}`}
            >
              {showLocal && onnxPreset ? (
                <LocalServiceCard
                  preset={onnxPreset}
                  provider={onnxProvider}
                  onSaved={handleSaved}
                  isHover={hoveredCard === "onnx"}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCard("onnx")}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCard(null)}
                />
              ) : null}
              {showCloud
                ? cloudEmbeddingPresets.map((preset) => (
                    <PresetProviderCard
                      key={preset.id}
                      preset={preset}
                      providers={providers}
                      onSaved={handleSaved}
                      isHover={hoveredCard === `preset-${preset.id}`}
                      onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCard(`preset-${preset.id}`)}
                      onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCard(null)}
                    />
                  ))
                : null}
              {showCloud
                ? customEmbeddingProviders.map((provider) => (
                    <ProviderCard
                      key={provider.id}
                      provider={provider}
                      onSaved={handleSaved}
                      isHover={hoveredCard === `p-${provider.id}`}
                      onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCard(`p-${provider.id}`)}
                      onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCard(null)}
                      apiPrefix="/admin/providers"
                    />
                  ))
                : null}
              {showCloud ? (
                <AddProviderCard
                  onClick={() => setAddOpen(true)}
                  isHover={hoveredCard === "add"}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCard("add")}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCard(null)}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
          {showCloud ? (
            <CustomProviderModal
              open={addOpen}
              onClose={() => setAddOpen(false)}
              onSaved={handleSaved}
              apiPrefix="/admin/providers"
              purpose="embedding"
            />
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { decisionApi, type LayaStatus } from "../../../../api/modules/decision";
import { LayaLocalInstall } from "./LayaLocalInstall";

vi.mock("../../../../api/modules/decision", () => ({
  decisionApi: {
    layaStatus: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

const running: LayaStatus = {
  installed: true,
  running: true,
  managed: true,
  phase: "running",
  endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/systemone",
  port: 8000,
  command: "",
  logs: [],
};

describe("LayaLocalInstall", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.mocked(decisionApi.layaStatus).mockResolvedValue(running);
  });

  it("separates service readiness from being the active default", async () => {
    const onStatusChange = vi.fn();
    const { rerender } = render(
      <LayaLocalInstall
        active={false}
        onReady={vi.fn()}
        onStatusChange={onStatusChange}
      />,
    );

    expect(
      await screen.findByText("models.decisionServiceReady"),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByText("models.decisionDefaultInactive"),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onStatusChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(running);

    rerender(
      <LayaLocalInstall
        active
        onReady={vi.fn()}
        onStatusChange={onStatusChange}
      />,
    );
    expect(
      screen.getByText("models.decisionDefaultActive"),

  });
});
````

````typescript
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Alert, App, Button } from "antd";
import { Copy, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import {
  decisionApi,
  type LayaPhase,
  type LayaStatus,
} from "../../../../api/modules/decision";
import { copyText } from "../../../../utils/copyText";
import { apiErrorMessage } from "../../../../utils/apiError";
import styles from "./DecisionSettingsPanel.module.less";

const EMPTY: LayaStatus = {
  installed: false,
  running: false,
  managed: false,
  phase: "missing",
  endpoint: "",
  port: 8000,
  command: "",
  logs: [],
};

export function LayaLocalInstall({
  active,
  onReady,
  onStatusChange,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onReady: () => void;
  onStatusChange: (status: LayaStatus) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<LayaStatus>(EMPTY);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const logRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const installRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const apply = useCallback(
    (next: LayaStatus) => {
      setStatus(next);
      onStatusChange(next);
      if (next.logs.length > 0) setLogs(next.logs);
    },
    [onStatusChange],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    void decisionApi
      .layaStatus()
      .then((next) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        apply(next);
        if (next.phase === "installing") startInstall();
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      installRef.current?.abort();
    };
    // Attach once when the Laya drawer opens.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status.phase !== "starting") return undefined;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      void decisionApi
        .layaStatus()
        .then(apply)
        .catch(() => undefined);
    }, 2000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [apply, status.phase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (logRef.current) {
      logRef.current.scrollTop = logRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [logs]);

  const startInstall = () => {
    if (installRef.current) return;
    setStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, phase: "installing" }));
    setLogs([]);
    installRef.current = decisionApi.installLaya(
      (line) => setLogs((prev) => [...prev, line]),
      (success) => {
        installRef.current = null;
        void decisionApi
          .layaStatus()
          .then((next) => {
            apply(next);
            if (success) {
              onReady();
              message.success(t("models.decisionLayaReadyHint"));
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {
            setStatus((prev) => ({
              ...prev,
              phase: success ? "running" : "failed",
            }));
          });
      },
    );
  };

  const phaseLabel: Record<LayaPhase, string> = {
    missing: t("models.decisionLayaMissing"),
    installing: t("models.decisionLayaInstalling"),
    starting: t("models.decisionLayaStarting"),
    running: t("models.decisionLayaRunning"),
    stopped: t("models.decisionLayaStopped"),
    failed: t("models.decisionLayaFailed"),
  };

  const copyLog = async () => {
    const body =
      logs.length > 0 ? logs.join("\n") : t("common.installLogEmpty");
    const command = status.command ? `\n${status.command}\n` : "";
    const payload = `${t("models.decisionLayaFailed")}\n${t(
      "models.decisionLayaFailGuide",
    )}\n${command}\n${body}`;
    const ok = await copyText(payload);
    if (ok) message.success(t("common.copied"));
    else message.error(t("common.copyFailed"));
  };

  const copyCommand = async () => {
    if (!status.command) return;
    const ok = await copyText(status.command);
    if (ok) message.success(t("common.copied"));
    else message.error(t("common.copyFailed"));
  };

  const run = async (action: "start" | "stop") => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const next =
        action === "start"
          ? await decisionApi.startLaya()
          : await decisionApi.stopLaya();
      apply(next);
    } catch (error) {
      message.error(apiErrorMessage(error, t("common.saveFailed"), t));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const showLog =
    status.phase === "installing" ||
    status.phase === "starting" ||
    status.phase === "failed" ||
    logs.length > 0;
  const external = status.running && !status.managed;

  return (
    <div className={styles.installCard}>
      <div className={styles.installHead}>
        <span className={styles.configSectionTitle}>
          {t("models.decisionLayaInstallTitle")}
        </span>
        <span className={styles.installPhase}>{phaseLabel[status.phase]}</span>
      </div>
      <p className={styles.installDesc}>
        {t("models.decisionLayaInstallDesc")}
      </p>
      <div className={styles.serviceStatus}>
        <span
          className={`${styles.serviceStatusItem} ${
            status.running ? styles.serviceStatusReady : ""
          }`}
        >
          <span className={styles.serviceStatusDot} />
          {status.running
            ? t("models.decisionServiceReady")
            : t("models.decisionServiceNotReady")}
        </span>
        <span
          className={`${styles.serviceStatusItem} ${
            active ? styles.serviceStatusActive : ""
          }`}
        >
          <span className={styles.serviceStatusDot} />
          {active
            ? t("models.decisionDefaultActive")
            : t("models.decisionDefaultInactive")}
        </span>
      </div>
      {status.command ? (
        <div>
          <div className={styles.installHead}>
            <span className={styles.installPhase}>
              {t("models.decisionLayaCommand")}
            </span>
            <Button
              size="small"
              icon={<Copy size={14} />}
              onClick={() => void copyCommand()}
            >
              {t("models.decisionLayaCopyCommand")}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <pre className={styles.installCommand}>{status.command}</pre>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {external ? (
        <Alert
          type="info"
          showIcon
          message={t("models.decisionLayaExternal")}
        />
      ) : null}
      {(status.phase === "installing" || status.phase === "starting") && (
        <div className={styles.installProgressTitle}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={styles.installSpin} />
          {phaseLabel[status.phase]}
        </div>
      )}
      {showLog ? (
        <div ref={logRef} className={styles.installLog}>
          {logs.length === 0 ? (
            <div>{t("models.decisionLayaInstalling")}</div>
          ) : (
            logs.map((line, index) => (
              <div key={`${index}-${line}`}>{line}</div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {status.phase === "failed" ? (
        <Alert
          type="error"
          showIcon
          message={t("models.decisionLayaFailed")}
          description={t("models.decisionLayaFailGuide")}
        />
      ) : null}
      <div className={styles.installActions}>
        {external ? (
          <Button type="primary" onClick={onReady}>
            {t("models.decisionLayaUseLocal")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {!external &&
        (status.phase === "missing" || status.phase === "failed") ? (
          <Button type="primary" onClick={startInstall}>
            {status.phase === "failed"
              ? t("models.decisionLayaInstallRetry")
              : t("models.decisionLayaInstall")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {!external && status.phase === "stopped" ? (
          <>
            <Button
              type="primary"
              loading={busy}
              onClick={() => void run("start")}
            >
              {t("models.decisionLayaStart")}
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={startInstall}>
              {t("models.decisionLayaInstallRetry")}
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : null}
        {status.managed && status.phase === "running" ? (
          <Button loading={busy} onClick={() => void run("stop")}>
            {t("models.decisionLayaStop")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        {status.phase === "failed" ? (
          <Button icon={<Copy size={14} />} onClick={() => void copyLog()}>
            {t("common.copyErrorForOctop")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Card-grid picker for preset initial models (name, hint, context, modalities).
 */
import { Button, Checkbox, Space, Typography } from "antd";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { enrichWizardModel } from "../wizardModelMeta";
import type { ProviderPresetModel } from "../useProviders";
import { ModelMetaTags } from "../modelMeta";
import styles from "../index.module.less";

const { Text } = Typography;

interface PresetModelPickerProps {
  models: ProviderPresetModel[];
  value?: string[];
  onChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
}

function ModelTileBody({ model }: { model: ProviderPresetModel }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const meta = enrichWizardModel(model, t);

  return (
    <div className={styles.presetModelTileBody}>
      <span className={styles.presetModelName}>{model.name}</span>
      {model.name !== model.id && (
        <span className={styles.presetModelId}>{model.id}</span>
      )}
      <span className={styles.presetModelDesc}>{meta.description}</span>
      <ModelMetaTags
        includeText
        input={meta.input}
        reasoning={meta.reasoning}
        context_window={meta.context_window}
        max_tokens={meta.max_tokens}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export function PresetModelPicker({
  models,
  value = [],
  onChange,
}: PresetModelPickerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const handleSelectAll = () => {
    onChange?.(models.map((m) => m.id));
  };

  const handleDeselectAll = () => {
    onChange?.([]);
  };

  if (models.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.presetModelEmpty}>{t("models.noModels")}</div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.presetModelPicker}>
      <div className={styles.presetModelPickerHeader}>
        <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
          {t("models.initialModelsHint")}
        </Text>
        <Space size={4}>
          <Button type="link" size="small" onClick={handleSelectAll}>
            {t("models.selectAllModels")}
          </Button>
          <Button type="link" size="small" onClick={handleDeselectAll}>
            {t("models.deselectAllModels")}
          </Button>
        </Space>
      </div>

      <Checkbox.Group
        className={styles.presetModelGrid}
        value={value}
        onChange={(ids) => onChange?.(ids as string[])}
      >
        {models.map((m) => (
          <Checkbox key={m.id} value={m.id} className={styles.presetModelTile}>
            <ModelTileBody model={m} />
          </Checkbox>
        ))}
      </Checkbox.Group>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { Steps } from "antd";

import styles from "../index.module.less";

interface SetupDrawerStepsProps {
  /** 0 = credentials, 1 = models, 2 = ready to test/create */
  current: number;
}

export function SetupDrawerSteps({ current }: SetupDrawerStepsProps) {

        ]}
````

## File: dashboard/src/pages/Settings/Models/components/StreamUsageAdvanced.test.tsx
````typescript
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { Form } from "antd";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { StreamUsageAdvanced } from "./StreamUsageAdvanced";

function renderFold() {
  return render(
    <Form initialValues={{ stream_usage: true }}>
      <StreamUsageAdvanced />
    </Form>,
  );
}

describe("StreamUsageAdvanced", () => {
  it("stays collapsed by default and keeps the form field mounted", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderFold();

    expect(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "models.compatibility" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText("models.streamUsage")).not.toBeVisible();

    await user.click(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "models.compatibility" }),
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("models.streamUsage")).toBeVisible();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "models.hideCompatibility" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Form, Switch } from "antd";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

/** Provider compatibility: live token counts via stream_options.include_usage. */
export function StreamUsageAdvanced() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div>
      <div
        style={{
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 6,
          marginBottom: open ? 8 : 12,
        }}
      >
        <Button
          type="link"
          size="small"
          style={{ padding: 0 }}
          icon={open ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        >
          {open ? t("models.hideCompatibility") : t("models.compatibility")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: open ? undefined : "none" }}>
        <Form.Item
          name="stream_usage"
          label={t("models.streamUsage")}
          extra={t("models.streamUsageHint")}
          valuePropName="checked"
        >
          <Switch size="small" />
        </Form.Item>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````
