````python
"""Manual checkpoint maintenance owned by the running host, not a second runtime."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import suppress
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from octop.i18n import tr
from octop.infra.errors import OctopError

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from octop.infra.agents.manager import AgentManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MemorySlimCoordinator:
    """One maintenance job per host; graph admission uses the existing idle reservation."""

    def __init__(self, agent_manager: AgentManager) -> None:
        self._agent_manager = agent_manager
        self.task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self.agent_id: str | None = None
        self.state: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._chat_owner: int | None = None
        self._chat_states: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._chat_phase = "idle"
        self._closing = False
        self._remove_directories = False
        self._storage_states: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def status(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if agent_id in self._chat_states:
            return {**self._chat_states[agent_id], "kind": "memory_slim"}
        return {**self.state, "kind": "memory_slim"} if agent_id == self.agent_id else None

    @property
    def busy(self) -> bool:
        return self.task is not None and not self.task.done()

    def storage_status(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Keep each expert's last page job visible across navigation."""
        return {"busy": self.busy, "job": self._storage_states.get(agent_id)}

    def _storage_target(self, agent_id: str, locale: str) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.storage import sqlite_store_is_shared

        kind = self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale)
        memory = self._agent_manager.get_agent(agent_id)._memory_runtime.memory
        assert memory is not None  # Validated by _memory_kind without yielding.
        if kind == "postgres":
            from octop.infra.agents.memory.thread_cleanup import memory_namespace

            namespace = memory.backend._ns
            if namespace != memory_namespace(agent_id):
                raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.namespace_mismatch", locale))
            # Agent IDs differing only by case/punctuation can normalize to the
            # same memory namespace. Refuse rather than touching shared data.
            if any(
                row.agent_id != agent_id and memory_namespace(row.agent_id) == namespace
                for row in self._agent_manager._repos.agent_repo.list_all(include_disabled=True)
            ):
                return memory, "shared_namespace"
            return memory, None
        if sqlite_store_is_shared(self._agent_manager, agent_id, memory):
            return memory, "shared_sqlite"
        try:
            self._require_memory(agent_id, locale)
        except ValueError:
            return memory, "incompatible"
        return memory, None

    async def inspect_storage(self, agent_id: str, *, locale: str = "en") -> dict[str, Any]:
        from functools import partial

        from octop.infra.agents.memory.storage import inspect_storage

        self._check_ready(locale)
        memory, blocked_reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
        return await asyncio.get_running_loop().run_in_executor(
            None, partial(inspect_storage, memory, blocked_reason=blocked_reason)
        )

    def start_current(self, agent_id: str, owner_id: int, *, locale: str = "en") -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Page action: this expert's SQLite file or PostgreSQL namespace."""
        self._check_ready(locale)
        self._assert_owner(agent_id, owner_id, locale)
        _memory, reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
        if reason:
            raise ValueError(tr(f"memory_storage.{reason}", locale))
        self._chat_owner = None
        self._chat_states = {}
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.state = {
            "job_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "scope": "agent",
            "backend": self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale),
            "phase": "waiting",
            "started_at": time.time(),
            "updated_at": time.time(),
        }
        self._storage_states[agent_id] = self.state
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(
            self._run(agent_id, locale, owner_id=owner_id, current_only=True)
        )
        return self.storage_status(agent_id)

    async def backups(self, agent_id: str, *, locale: str = "en") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.sqlite_restore import list_backups

        memory, reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
        if self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale) != "sqlite" or reason:
            return []
        path = Path(memory.backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
        return await asyncio.to_thread(list_backups, path)

    async def delete_backup(
        self, agent_id: str, owner_id: int, backup_id: str, *, locale: str = "en"
    ) -> None:
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.sqlite_restore import delete_backup

        self._check_ready(locale)
        self._assert_owner(agent_id, owner_id, locale)
        memory, reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
        if self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale) != "sqlite" or reason:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.delete_sqlite_only", locale))
        path = Path(memory.backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
        # Reserve the same coordinator slot as maintenance/restore before yielding.
        # Shield keeps deletion tracked even if the HTTP client disconnects.
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(delete_backup, path, backup_id, locale))
        await asyncio.shield(self.task)

    def start_restore(
        self, agent_id: str, owner_id: int, backup_id: str, *, locale: str = "en"
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.sqlite_restore import backup_path

        self._check_ready(locale)
        self._assert_owner(agent_id, owner_id, locale)
        memory, reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
        if self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale) != "sqlite" or reason:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.restore_sqlite_only", locale))
        path = Path(memory.backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
        backup_path(path, backup_id, locale)
        self._chat_owner = None
        self._chat_states = {}
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.state = {
            "job_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "scope": "agent",
            "backend": "sqlite",
            "operation": "restore",
            "phase": "waiting",
            "started_at": time.time(),
            "updated_at": time.time(),
            "restored_backup_id": backup_id,
        }
        self._storage_states[agent_id] = self.state
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(
            self._run_restore(agent_id, owner_id, path, backup_id, locale)
        )
        return self.storage_status(agent_id)

    async def _run_restore(
        self, agent_id: str, owner_id: int, path: Path, backup_id: str, locale: str
    ) -> None:
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.sqlite_restore import restore_sqlite

        registry = self._agent_manager
        reserved = False
        try:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 120
            while agent_id in registry._reclaim_holds or not registry.try_begin_history_backfill(
                agent_id
            ):
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.wait_timeout", locale))
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            reserved = True
            self._assert_owner(agent_id, owner_id, locale)
            memory, reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
            if reason or Path(memory.backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True) != path:
                raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.restore_changed", locale))
            self._update({"phase": "draining"})
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

            def progress(values: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
                loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._update, values)

            def operation() -> dict[str, Any]:
                from octop.infra.agents.memory.storage import sqlite_store_is_shared

                self._assert_owner(agent_id, owner_id, locale)
                if sqlite_store_is_shared(registry, agent_id, memory):
                    raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.shared_sqlite", locale))
                result = restore_sqlite(
                    path, str(memory.backend._ns), backup_id, locale=locale, progress=progress
                )
                progress({"phase": "restarting", "report": result})
                return result

            result = await registry.restore_memory_store(agent_id, memory, operation, locale=locale)
            self._update({"phase": "done", "report": result})
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            self._update({"phase": "failed", "error": tr("memory_slim.interrupted", locale)})
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Memory restore failed for agent=%s", agent_id)
            self._update(
                {
                    "phase": "failed",
                    "error": tr("memory_slim.error_detail", locale, detail=str(exc)),
                }
            )
        finally:
            if reserved:
                registry.end_history_backfill(agent_id)

    def list_agents(self, *, locale: str = "en") -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """List compatible live agents without opening another memory connection."""
        if self._closing:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.not_ready", locale))
        self._require_live_support(locale)
        registry = self._agent_manager
        result = []
        for row in registry.list_rows():
            try:
                self._memory_kind(row.agent_id, locale)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            result.append({"agent_id": row.agent_id, "name": row.name})
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _require_live_support(locale: str) -> None:
        from octop_memory.application import checkpoint_maintenance

        if not callable(getattr(checkpoint_maintenance, "slim_live_checkpoints", None)):
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.upgrade", locale))

    def _require_memory(self, agent_id: str, locale: str) -> Any:
        from octop_memory.storage.backends.sqlite import SqliteMemoryBackend
        from octop_memory.storage.backends.sqlite_checkpoint import CompactSqliteSaver

        try:
            agent = self._agent_manager.get_agent(agent_id)
        except OctopError as exc:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.agent_not_running", locale)) from exc
        memory = getattr(getattr(agent, "_memory_runtime", None), "memory", None)
        if memory is None:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.memory_disabled", locale))
        if not isinstance(memory.backend, SqliteMemoryBackend):
            backend = type(memory.backend).__name__
            if backend == "PostgresMemoryBackend":
                raise ValueError(
                    tr("memory_slim.postgres_unsupported", locale, backend="PostgreSQL")
                )
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.backend_unsupported", locale, backend=backend))
        saver = getattr(memory, "_checkpointer", None)
        if not isinstance(saver, CompactSqliteSaver) or not hasattr(saver.codec, "with_connection"):
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.incompatible", locale))
        self._require_live_support(locale)
        return memory

    def _memory_kind(self, agent_id: str, locale: str) -> str:
        """``sqlite`` or ``postgres`` when the live agent has a memory store."""
        try:
            agent = self._agent_manager.get_agent(agent_id)
        except OctopError as exc:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.agent_not_running", locale)) from exc
        memory = getattr(getattr(agent, "_memory_runtime", None), "memory", None)
        if memory is None:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.memory_disabled", locale))
        backend = type(getattr(memory, "backend", None)).__name__
        if backend == "SqliteMemoryBackend":
            return "sqlite"
        if backend == "PostgresMemoryBackend":
            return "postgres"
        raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.backend_unsupported", locale, backend=backend))

    def _check_ready(self, locale: str) -> None:
        if self.task is not None and not self.task.done():
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.busy", locale))
        if self._closing:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.not_ready", locale))

    def orphan_directories(self) -> list[str]:
        """Host directories whose names match no current agent. Does not delete."""
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.thread_cleanup import list_deleted_agent_dirs

        repos = getattr(self._agent_manager, "_repos", None)
        paths = getattr(self._agent_manager, "_paths", None)
        if repos is None or paths is None:
            return []
        live_ids = {str(row.agent_id) for row in repos.agent_repo.list_all(include_disabled=True)}
        return [str(path) for path in list_deleted_agent_dirs(paths, live_ids)]

    def start(self, agent_id: str, *, locale: str = "en", remove_directories: bool = False) -> None:
        self._check_ready(locale)
        self._chat_owner = None
        self._chat_states = {}
        self._remove_directories = remove_directories
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.state = {"phase": "waiting", "started_at": time.time(), "updated_at": time.time()}
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._run(agent_id, locale))

    def _assert_owner(self, agent_id: str, user_id: int, locale: str) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.not_ready", locale))
        row = self._agent_manager.get_row(agent_id)
        if user_id <= 0 or row is None or row.user_id != user_id:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.forbidden", locale))

    def preview_chat(
        self, agent_id: str, user_id: int, *, all_agents: bool = False, locale: str = "en"
    ) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """List the user's eligible targets without scheduling or touching memory files."""
        if self._closing:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.not_ready", locale))
        registry = self._agent_manager
        if user_id <= 0:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.forbidden", locale))
        if not all_agents:
            self._assert_owner(agent_id, user_id, locale)
            # Diagnose the requested agent before filtering the global list.
            self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale)
        owned = {row.agent_id for row in registry.list_agents(user_id)}
        targets = [
            row
            for row in self.list_agents(locale=locale)
            if row["agent_id"] in owned and (all_agents or row["agent_id"] == agent_id)
        ]
        if not targets:
            raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.no_agents", locale))
        return targets

    def start_chat(
        self,
        agent_id: str,
        user_id: int,
        *,
        all_agents: bool = False,
        locale: str = "en",
        remove_directories: bool = False,
    ) -> int:
        """Start a host-owned queue limited to the authenticated user's own agents."""
        self._check_ready(locale)
        targets = [
            row["agent_id"]
            for row in self.preview_chat(agent_id, user_id, all_agents=all_agents, locale=locale)
        ]
        self._chat_owner = user_id
        self._remove_directories = remove_directories
        self._chat_states = {aid: {"phase": "queued"} for aid in targets}
        self._chat_phase = "running"
        self.agent_id = targets[0]
        self.state = self._chat_states[targets[0]]
        self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._run_chat(targets, user_id, locale))
        return len(targets)

    def chat_status(self, agent_id: str, user_id: int, *, locale: str = "en") -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._chat_owner == user_id:
            states = self._chat_states
            phase = self._chat_phase
        else:
            self._assert_owner(agent_id, user_id, locale)
            state = self.status(agent_id)
            states = {agent_id: state} if state is not None else {}
            phase = str(state["phase"]) if state is not None else "idle"
        # Ownership may have changed since the request was accepted.
        for aid in states:
            self._assert_owner(aid, user_id, locale)
        return {
            "phase": phase,
            "agents": [{"agent_id": aid, **state} for aid, state in states.items()],
        }

    async def _run_chat(self, targets: list[str], user_id: int, locale: str) -> None:
        try:
            for aid in targets:
                if self._closing:
                    break
                self.agent_id = aid
                self.state = self._chat_states[aid]
                self._update({"phase": "waiting", "started_at": time.time()})
                try:
                    self._assert_owner(aid, user_id, locale)
                except ValueError as exc:
                    self._update({"phase": "failed", "error": str(exc)})
                    break
                await self._run(aid, locale, owner_id=user_id)
                if self.state.get("phase") != "done":
                    break
            self._chat_phase = (
                "done"
                if all(s["phase"] == "done" for s in self._chat_states.values())
                else "failed"
            )
        finally:
            if self._chat_phase == "running":
                self._chat_phase = "failed"
            for state in self._chat_states.values():
                if state["phase"] == "queued":
                    state["phase"] = "skipped"

    def _update(self, values: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.state.update(values, updated_at=time.time())

    async def _run(
        self, agent_id: str, locale: str, *, owner_id: int | None = None, current_only: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        registry = self._agent_manager
        reserved = False
        try:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 120
            while not registry.try_begin_history_backfill(agent_id):
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.wait_timeout", locale))
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            reserved = True
            if owner_id is not None:
                self._assert_owner(agent_id, owner_id, locale)
            from octop.infra.agents.memory.thread_cleanup import (  # noqa: PLC0415
                sweep_deleted_residuals,
            )

            sweep: dict[str, Any] = {}
            if current_only:
                # Recheck after waiting: ownership/backend/config may have changed.
                _memory, reason = self._storage_target(agent_id, locale)
                if reason:
                    raise ValueError(tr(f"memory_storage.{reason}", locale))
            else:
                sweep = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    sweep_deleted_residuals,
                    registry,
                    remove_directories=self._remove_directories,
                )
                self._update({"phase": "sweeping", "sweep": sweep})
            if self._memory_kind(agent_id, locale) == "postgres":
                if current_only:
                    await self._run_postgres(_memory, locale)
                else:
                    self._update({"phase": "done", "sweep": sweep, "dedup_skipped": True})
                return
            from octop_memory.application import checkpoint_maintenance

            slim_live_checkpoints = getattr(checkpoint_maintenance, "slim_live_checkpoints", None)
            if not callable(slim_live_checkpoints):
                raise ValueError(tr("memory_slim.upgrade", locale))

            memory = self._require_memory(agent_id, locale)
            # Ask the live saver for its actual file; never infer a path from agent_id.
            # Its connection may be busy, so use the existing backend's configured path.
            path = Path(memory.backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
            backup = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.before-slim.{uuid.uuid4().hex}.bak")
            self._update(
                {
                    "phase": "backing_up",
                    "backup_path": str(backup),
                    "file_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                }
            )
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

            def progress(values: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
                loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._update, values)

            # Joining the worker before releasing the gate is essential: cancelling
            # an asyncio to_thread await does not stop the SQLite operation.
            def maintain() -> dict[str, Any]:
                from octop.infra.agents.memory.storage import inspect_storage

                before = inspect_storage(memory, blocked_reason=None) if current_only else None
                if before and not before["maintenance_supported"]:
                    raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.shared_sqlite", locale))
                result: dict[str, Any] = slim_live_checkpoints(
                    path, backup=backup, progress=progress
                )
                if before is not None:
                    result["inspection_before"] = before
                    result["inspection_after"] = inspect_storage(memory, blocked_reason=None)
                return result

            worker = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(maintain))
            try:
                report = await asyncio.shield(worker)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                await worker
                raise
            self._update({"phase": "done", "report": report, "sweep": sweep})
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            self._update({"phase": "failed", "error": tr("memory_slim.interrupted", locale)})
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            if self.state.get("backup_path") and not Path(self.state["backup_path"]).is_file():
                self.state.pop("backup_path", None)
            logger.exception("Memory maintenance failed for agent=%s", agent_id)
            self._update(
                {
                    "phase": "failed",
                    "error": tr("memory_slim.error_detail", locale, detail=str(exc)),
                }
            )
        finally:
            if reserved:
                registry.end_history_backfill(agent_id)

    async def _run_postgres(self, memory: Any, locale: str) -> None:
        from functools import partial

        from octop.infra.agents.memory.postgres_storage import maintain_postgres_storage

        backup = (
            self._agent_manager._paths.root
            / "backups"
            / "memory-maintenance"
            / f"{self.state['job_id']}.jsonl"
        )
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

        def progress(values: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._update, values)

        worker = loop.run_in_executor(
            None,
            partial(
                maintain_postgres_storage,
                memory.backend,
                backup=backup,
                progress=progress,
                locale=locale,
            ),
        )
        try:
            report = await asyncio.shield(worker)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            await worker
            raise
        self._update({"phase": "done", "report": report, "scanned": report["total_deleted"]})

    async def close(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        if self.task is not None and not self.task.done():
            if self.state.get("phase") == "waiting":
                self.task.cancel()
            with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await self.task
````

````python
"""Restore a dedicated SQLite memory file after its runtime has been drained."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import sqlite3
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from octop.i18n import tr


def backup_path(path: Path, backup_id: str, locale: str) -> Path:
    pattern = re.escape(path.name) + r"\.before-(?:slim|restore)\.[0-9a-f]{32}\.bak"
    candidate = path.parent / backup_id
    if not re.fullmatch(pattern, backup_id) or candidate.is_symlink() or not candidate.is_file():
        raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.invalid_backup", locale))
    return candidate


def list_backups(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    result = []
    for candidate in path.parent.glob(f"{path.name}.before-*.bak"):
        try:
            backup_path(path, candidate.name, "en")
            stat = candidate.stat()
        except (ValueError, OSError):
            continue
        result.append(
            {
                "backup_id": candidate.name,
                "created_at": stat.st_mtime,
                "size_bytes": stat.st_size,
                "kind": "before_restore"
                if ".before-restore." in candidate.name
                else "before_maintenance",
            }
        )
    return sorted(result, key=lambda item: item["created_at"], reverse=True)


def delete_backup(path: Path, backup_id: str, locale: str) -> None:
    """Delete one eligible sibling backup, never the active database."""
    candidate = backup_path(path, backup_id, locale)
    try:
        candidate.unlink()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.delete_backup_failed", locale)) from exc


def _validate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, namespace: str, locale: str) -> None:
    from octop_memory.storage.backends.sqlite_checkpoint import CompactSqliteSaver

    if conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0] != "ok":
        raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.invalid_backup", locale))
    tables = {row[0] for row in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")}
    namespaces = {
        name.removesuffix("_raw_events") for name in tables if name.endswith("_raw_events")
    }
    if namespaces != {namespace} or not {"checkpoints", "writes"}.issubset(tables):
        raise ValueError(tr("memory_storage.backup_scope", locale))
    # Check reference payloads as well as SQLite pages before overwriting anything.
    codec = CompactSqliteSaver(conn).codec
    for kind, value in conn.execute("SELECT type, checkpoint FROM checkpoints"):
        codec.loads_typed((kind, value))


def restore_sqlite(
    path: Path,
    namespace: str,
    backup_id: str,
    *,
    locale: str,
    progress: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], None],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate, snapshot current data durably, then use SQLite's backup API.

    Restore in-place so WAL and any idle read handles remain SQLite-managed.
    No path supplied by the client is accepted; backups must be regular siblings
    matching the host's backup naming scheme and the exact memory namespace.
    """
    source = backup_path(path, backup_id, locale)
    safety = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.before-restore.{uuid.uuid4().hex}.bak")
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(source.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=5)) as src:
        src.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        src.execute("BEGIN")
        progress({"phase": "validating"})
        _validate(src, namespace, locale)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri() + "?mode=rw", uri=True, timeout=5)) as dest:
            _validate(dest, namespace, locale)
            progress({"phase": "backing_up_current"})
            fd = os.open(safety, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
            os.close(fd)
            try:
                with closing(sqlite3.connect(safety)) as saved:
                    dest.backup(saved)
                    _validate(saved, namespace, locale)
                # Windows requires a writable handle for fsync. Do not truncate
                # the snapshot: it must be durable before overwriting the store.
                with safety.open("r+b") as saved_file:
                    os.fsync(saved_file.fileno())
            except BaseException:
                safety.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                raise
            progress({"phase": "restoring", "backup_path": str(safety)})
            try:
                src.backup(dest)
                _validate(dest, namespace, locale)
            except BaseException:
                # The host has stopped all writers; restoring this snapshot cannot
                # discard writes made after it. Always retain it for manual recovery.
                with closing(sqlite3.connect(safety.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)) as saved:
                    saved.backup(dest)
                raise
            dest.execute("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)")
    return {
        "backend": "sqlite",
        "operation": "restore",
        "restored_backup_id": backup_id,
        "backup_path": str(safety),
        "backup_bytes": safety.stat().st_size,
        "elapsed_ms": (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000,
    }
````

## File: src/octop/infra/agents/memory/sqlite_storage.py
````python
"""Read-only, bounded SQLite diagnostics for one expert's memory store."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

MEMORY_TABLES = (
    "raw_events",
    "candidates",
    "atoms",
    "entities",
    "aliases",
    "entity_pages",
    "memory_nodes",
    "thread_active_entities",
    "journal",
    "episodes",
    "digests",
)
CHECKPOINT_TABLES = ("checkpoints", "writes", "hm_checkpoint_blobs")
COUNT_BUDGET_SECONDS = 5.0


def inspect_sqlite_storage(backend: Any, *, shared: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Use a separate read-only snapshot; never initialize or migrate a store.

    Unprefixed checkpoint tables cannot be attributed to an expert in a shared
    file. In that case return only the selected namespace's memory counts.
    """
    started = time.perf_counter()
    path = Path(backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
    namespace = str(backend._ns)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=2)) as conn:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        conn.execute("BEGIN")
        names = {
            row[0] for row in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
        }
        # Also detect residual namespaces that no longer have a registry row.
        shared = shared or any(
            name.endswith("_raw_events") and name != f"{namespace}_raw_events" for name in names
        )
        page_size = conn.execute("PRAGMA page_size").fetchone()[0]
        pages = conn.execute("PRAGMA page_count").fetchone()[0]
        free = conn.execute("PRAGMA freelist_count").fetchone()[0]
        auto_vacuum = conn.execute("PRAGMA auto_vacuum").fetchone()[0] == 2
        wal = Path(str(path) + "-wal")
        try:
            wal_size = wal.stat().st_size
        except FileNotFoundError:
            wal_size = 0
        report: dict[str, Any] = {
            "file_size": path.stat().st_size,
            "wal_size": wal_size,
            "page_size": page_size,
            "total_pages": pages,
            "freelist_pages": free,
            "reclaimable_bytes": free * page_size,
            "auto_vacuum_enabled": auto_vacuum,
            "file_check_ms": (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000,
            "namespace": namespace,
            "checkpoints_available": not shared,
        }
        deadline = time.perf_counter() + COUNT_BUDGET_SECONDS
        conn.set_progress_handler(lambda: int(time.perf_counter() >= deadline), 1000)

        def count(label: str, table: str, expression: str = "count(*)") -> dict[str, Any]:
            begin = time.perf_counter()
            rows = None
            status = "missing"
            if table in names:
                status = "timed_out"
                if begin < deadline:
                    quoted = '"' + table.replace('"', '""') + '"'
                    try:
                        rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT {expression} FROM {quoted}").fetchone()[0]
                        status = "ok"
                    except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
                        if str(exc) != "interrupted":
                            raise
            return {
                "table": label,
                "rows": rows,
                "status": status,
                "elapsed_ms": (time.perf_counter() - begin) * 1000,
            }

        report["memory_counts"] = [count(name, f"{namespace}_{name}") for name in MEMORY_TABLES]
        report["checkpoint_counts"] = (
            [count(name, name) for name in CHECKPOINT_TABLES]
            + [count("checkpoint_threads", "checkpoints", "count(DISTINCT thread_id)")]
            if not shared
            else []
        )
        conn.set_progress_handler(None, 0)
        conn.rollback()
    report["elapsed_ms"] = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    return report
````

## File: src/octop/infra/agents/memory/storage.py
````python
"""Read-only storage diagnostics and eligibility for single-agent maintenance."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from octop.infra.agents.memory.backend import open_memory_kwargs
from octop.infra.agents.memory.thread_cleanup import agent_config_from_row, workspace_for_agent_row


def sqlite_store_is_shared(registry: Any, agent_id: str, memory: Any) -> bool:
    """Include stopped agents: a file operation cannot be namespace-scoped."""
    path = Path(memory.backend._db_path).expanduser().resolve()
    for row in registry._repos.agent_repo.list_all(include_disabled=True):
        if row.agent_id == agent_id:
            continue
        _ns, backend, cfg = open_memory_kwargs(
            agent_id=row.agent_id,
            cfg=agent_config_from_row(row),
            octop_config=registry._config,
            workspace_dir=workspace_for_agent_row(row, paths=registry._paths),
        )
        if backend == "sqlite" and cfg and Path(cfg["db_path"]).expanduser().resolve() == path:
            return True
    return False


def inspect_storage(memory: Any, *, blocked_reason: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if type(memory.backend).__name__ == "PostgresMemoryBackend":
        from octop.infra.agents.memory.postgres_storage import inspect_postgres_storage

        return inspect_postgres_storage(memory.backend, blocked_reason=blocked_reason)
    from octop.infra.agents.memory.sqlite_storage import inspect_sqlite_storage

    report = inspect_sqlite_storage(memory.backend, shared=blocked_reason == "shared_sqlite")
    if not report["checkpoints_available"]:
        blocked_reason = "shared_sqlite"
    report.update(
        backend="sqlite",
        scope="shared_database" if blocked_reason in {"postgres", "shared_sqlite"} else "agent",
        maintenance_supported=blocked_reason is None,
        blocked_reason=blocked_reason,
        checked_at=time.time(),
    )
    return report
````

````python
"""Delete LangGraph checkpoints without a live HarnessAgent.

Conversation text lives in the agent's memory store (SQLite file or
Postgres), not in Octop's ``threads`` table. Callers delete checkpoints
first and drop the thread row only after this succeeds, so a failure
leaves the conversation visible and retryable.

agent's memory rows. Those tables are not foreign keys of ``agents``.

)

# octop_memory.pipeline.lifecycle.vacuum.DELETE_INCREMENTAL_VACUUM_PAGES.

    rows = services.agent_repo.list_all(include_disabled=True)
    if agent_id is not None:
        rows = [row for row in rows if row.agent_id == agent_id]
    found: list[OrphanCheckpoint] = []
    for row in rows:
        cfg = agent_config_from_row(row)
        workspace = workspace_for_agent_row(row, paths=services.paths)
        usage = checkpoint_thread_bytes(
            agent_id=row.agent_id,
            cfg=cfg,
            octop_config=services.config,
            workspace_dir=workspace,
        )
        known = services.thread_repo.list_ids_for_agent(row.agent_id)
        orphans = [
            OrphanCheckpoint(agent_id=row.agent_id, thread_id=tid, nbytes=nbytes)
            for tid, nbytes in usage.items()
            if tid not in known
        ]
        if apply:
            for orphan in orphans:
                delete_stored_thread(
                    agent_id=row.agent_id,
                    thread_id=orphan.thread_id,
                    cfg=cfg,
                    octop_config=services.config,
                    workspace_dir=workspace,
                )
        found.extend(orphans)
    return found


def close_memory(memory: Any) -> None:
    """Release the checkpointer connection and the memory backend."""
    cp = getattr(memory, "_checkpointer", None)
    conn = getattr(cp, "conn", None)
    if conn is not None:
        try:
            conn.close()
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("checkpoint connection close failed", exc_info=True)
    pool = getattr(memory, "_checkpointer_pool", None)
    closer = getattr(pool, "close", None)
    if closer is not None:
        try:
            closer()
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("checkpoint pool close failed", exc_info=True)
    backend = getattr(memory, "_backend", None)
    backend_close = getattr(backend, "close", None)
    if backend_close is not None:
        try:
            backend_close()
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("memory backend close failed", exc_info=True)


def agent_config_from_row(row: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw = getattr(row, "config_json", None)
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(raw or "{}")
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return {}
    return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}


def _memory_location(
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    octop_config: OctopConfig,
    workspace_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[str, str, dict[str, Any] | None, Path | None]:
    ns, backend, backend_config = open_memory_kwargs(
        agent_id=agent_id,
        cfg=cfg,
        octop_config=octop_config,
        workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
    )
    sqlite_path: Path | None = None
    if backend == "sqlite":
        raw = (backend_config or {}).get("db_path")
        if raw:
            sqlite_path = Path(str(raw))
        else:
            sqlite_path = host_system_dir(workspace_dir, cfg) / "memory.sqlite"
    return ns, backend, backend_config if isinstance(backend_config, dict) else None, sqlite_path


def _open_memory(ns: str, backend: str, backend_config: dict[str, Any] | None) -> Any:
    from octop_memory.core import Memory

    return Memory(namespace=ns, backend=backend, backend_config=backend_config)


def _sqlite_file_cfg(cfg: dict[str, Any], path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged = dict(cfg)
    memory = dict(merged.get("memory") or {}) if isinstance(merged.get("memory"), dict) else {}
    memory["backend"] = {"type": "sqlite", "db_path": str(path)}
    merged["memory"] = memory
    return merged


def _sqlite_memory_files(
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    paths: Any | None,
    workspace_dir: Path,
) -> list[Path]:
    """SQLite memory files for this agent, including ones outside the active workspace."""
    candidates = [
        host_system_dir(workspace_dir, cfg) / "memory.sqlite",
        workspace_dir / "memory.sqlite",
        workspace_dir / ".octop" / "memory.sqlite",
    ]
    if paths is not None:
        for directory in agent_host_data_dirs(cfg, paths=paths, agent_id=agent_id):
            candidates.append(directory / "memory.sqlite")
            candidates.append(directory / ".octop" / "memory.sqlite")
    found: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[Path] = set()
    for candidate in candidates:
        if not candidate.is_file():
            continue
        try:
            resolved = candidate.resolve()
        except OSError:
            resolved = candidate
        if resolved in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(resolved)
        found.append(resolved)
    return found


def _purge_sqlite_file(
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    octop_config: OctopConfig,
    workspace_dir: Path,
) -> None:
    _purge_agent_memory(
        agent_id=agent_id,
        cfg=cfg,
        octop_config=octop_config,
        workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
    )


def _purge_agent_memory(
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    octop_config: OctopConfig,
    workspace_dir: Path,
) -> None:
    ns, backend, backend_config, sqlite_path = _memory_location(
        agent_id=agent_id,
        cfg=cfg,
        octop_config=octop_config,
        workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
    )
    if backend == "sqlite" and (sqlite_path is None or not sqlite_path.is_file()):
        return
    memory = _open_memory(ns, backend, backend_config)
    try:
        store = getattr(memory, "_backend", None)
        if backend == "postgres":
            _purge_postgres_namespace(store)
        else:
            _drop_sqlite_namespace(store)
    finally:
        close_memory(memory)


def _quote_ident(name: str) -> str:
    if _IDENT.fullmatch(name) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unsafe SQL identifier: {name!r}")
    return f'"{name}"'


def _purge_postgres_namespace(store: Any) -> None:
    """Delete this namespace from every shared memory schema on the DSN."""
    import psycopg

    ns = str(getattr(store, "_ns", "") or "")
    dsn = str(getattr(store, "_dsn", "") or "")
    if _IDENT.fullmatch(ns) is None or not dsn:
        raise OctopError(
            ErrorCode.CHECKPOINT_DELETE_FAILED,
            "could not delete agent memory: backend namespace is missing",
        )
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True) as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT table_schema, table_name
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE column_name = 'namespace'
              AND table_name = ANY(%s)
              AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
            """,
            (list(_NAMESPACE_TABLES),),
        )
        for schema, table in cur.fetchall():
            schema_name, table_name = str(schema), str(table)
            if _IDENT.fullmatch(schema_name) is None or _IDENT.fullmatch(table_name) is None:
                continue
            cur.execute(
                f"DELETE FROM {_quote_ident(schema_name)}.{_quote_ident(table_name)} "
                "WHERE namespace = %s",
                (ns,),
            )
        for legacy in (ns, f"{ns[:56]}__old"):
            if legacy in _SHARED_MEMORY_SCHEMAS:
                continue
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = %s",
                (legacy,),
            )
            if cur.fetchone() is not None:
                cur.execute(f"DROP SCHEMA {_quote_ident(legacy)} CASCADE")


def _drop_sqlite_namespace(store: Any) -> None:
    """Drop this namespace's tables in a SQLite file that other agents may share."""
    ns = str(getattr(store, "_ns", "") or "")
    if _IDENT.fullmatch(ns) is None:
        return
    prefix = f"{ns}_"
    conn = store._conn
    rows = conn.execute("SELECT type, name FROM sqlite_master").fetchall()
    named = [(str(row[0]), str(row[1])) for row in rows if str(row[1]).startswith(prefix)]
    for kind, name in named:
        if kind == "trigger":
            conn.execute(f"DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS {_quote_ident(name)}")
    tables = [name for kind, name in named if kind in {"table", "view"} and "_fts_" not in name]
    for name in tables:
        if name.endswith("_fts"):
            conn.execute(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {_quote_ident(name)}")
    for name in tables:
        if not name.endswith("_fts"):
            conn.execute(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {_quote_ident(name)}")
    conn.commit()


def sqlite_freelist_bytes(path: Path) -> int:
    """Bytes sitting on SQLite's freelist. ``0`` when the file is missing."""
    if not path.is_file():
        return 0
    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(f"{path.resolve().as_uri()}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error):
        return 0
    try:
        page_row = conn.execute("PRAGMA page_size").fetchone()
        free_row = conn.execute("PRAGMA freelist_count").fetchone()
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return 0
    finally:
        conn.close()
    page = int(page_row[0] or 0) if page_row else 0
    free = int(free_row[0] or 0) if free_row else 0
    return page * free


def agent_sqlite_freelist_bytes(
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    octop_config: OctopConfig,
    workspace_dir: Path,
    paths: Any | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Free-page bytes across this agent's SQLite memory files."""
    found = _sqlite_memory_files(cfg, agent_id=agent_id, paths=paths, workspace_dir=workspace_dir)
    _ns, _backend, _backend_config, primary = _memory_location(
        agent_id=agent_id,
        cfg=cfg,
        octop_config=octop_config,
        workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
    )
    if primary is not None:
        found.append(primary)
    total = 0
    seen: set[Path] = set()
    for path in found:
        try:
            resolved = path.resolve()
        except OSError:
            resolved = path
        if resolved in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(resolved)
        total += sqlite_freelist_bytes(resolved)
    return total


def _store_file_bytes(path: Path) -> int:
    total = 0
    for candidate in (path, Path(str(path) + "-wal"), Path(str(path) + "-shm")):
        if candidate.is_file():
            total += candidate.stat().st_size
    return total


def _disk_allows_compact(path: Path) -> bool:
    """False when rewriting the file would need more free disk than remains."""
    try:
        free = shutil.disk_usage(path).free
        need = _store_file_bytes(path) + _COMPACT_DISK_MARGIN_BYTES
    except OSError:
        logger.warning("compact disk check failed path=%s", path, exc_info=True)
        return False
    if free < need:
        key = str(path)
        if key not in _compact_disk_warned:
            _compact_disk_warned.add(key)
            logger.warning("skip compact path=%s free=%s need=%s", path, free, need)
        return False
    _compact_disk_warned.discard(str(path))
    return True


def compact_live_sqlite(memory: Any) -> bool:
    """Rebuild one open SQLite memory store so deleted rows leave the file.

    Returns True when the store is not SQLite, or the rebuild finished.
    Returns False when disk is short or the rebuild failed, so the caller
    can retry after the expert is idle. Postgres is left to autovacuum:
    ``VACUUM FULL`` would lock checkpoint tables shared by every agent.
    """
    from octop_memory.storage.backends.sqlite import SqliteMemoryBackend

    backend = getattr(memory, "_backend", None)
    if not isinstance(backend, SqliteMemoryBackend):
        return True
    path = Path(backend._db_path)
    if not path.is_file():
        return True
    if not _disk_allows_compact(path):
        return False
    try:
        from octop_memory.pipeline.lifecycle.vacuum import compact_vacuum

        compact_vacuum(memory)
    except Exception:
        logger.warning("compact failed path=%s", path, exc_info=True)
        return False
    return True


def compact_agent_store_file(
    *,
    agent_id: str,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    octop_config: OctopConfig,
    workspace_dir: Path,
) -> bool:
    """Open this agent's store and compact it. The agent must not be loaded."""
    ns, backend, backend_config, sqlite_path = _memory_location(
        agent_id=agent_id,
        cfg=cfg,
        octop_config=octop_config,
        workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
    )
    if backend != "sqlite":
        return True
    if sqlite_path is None or not sqlite_path.is_file():
        return True
    memory = _open_memory(ns, backend, backend_config)
    try:
        return compact_live_sqlite(memory)
    finally:
        close_memory(memory)


def _reclaim_sqlite(memory: Any, *, agent_id: str, thread_id: str) -> None:
    from octop_memory.pipeline.lifecycle.vacuum import nudge_vacuum
    from octop_memory.storage.backends.sqlite import SqliteMemoryBackend

    if not isinstance(getattr(memory, "_backend", None), SqliteMemoryBackend):
        return
    try:
        nudge_vacuum(memory, pages=_DELETE_VACUUM_PAGES)
    except Exception:
        logger.warning(
            "checkpoint reclaim failed agent=%s thread=%s",
            agent_id,
            thread_id,
            exc_info=True,
        )


def _sqlite_thread_bytes(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        names = {
            str(row[0]) for row in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
        }
        if "checkpoints" not in names:
            return {}
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT thread_id, COALESCE(SUM(LENGTH(checkpoint)), 0) "
            "FROM checkpoints GROUP BY thread_id"
        ).fetchall()
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        if _store_has_no_checkpoints(exc):
            return {}
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return {str(thread_id): int(nbytes or 0) for thread_id, nbytes in rows}


def _postgres_thread_bytes(memory: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
    memory._ensure_checkpointer()
    saver = memory._checkpointer
    cursor = getattr(saver, "_cursor", None)
    if cursor is None:
        return {}
    try:
        with cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT thread_id, COALESCE(SUM(pg_column_size(checkpoint)), 0) AS nbytes "
                "FROM checkpoints GROUP BY thread_id"
            )
            rows = cur.fetchall()
    except Exception as exc:
        if _store_has_no_checkpoints(exc):
            return {}
        raise
    out: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            out[str(row["thread_id"])] = int(row["nbytes"] or 0)
        else:
            out[str(row[0])] = int(row[1] or 0)
    return out


def _store_has_no_checkpoints(exc: BaseException) -> bool:
    text = str(exc).lower()
    if "no such table" in text:
        return True
    return type(exc).__name__ == "UndefinedTable" or (
        "does not exist" in text and "checkpoint" in text
    )


def memory_namespace(agent_id: str) -> str:
    """Namespace stored for an agent, matching the memory backends."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]", "_", f"agent_{agent_id}".lower())


def sweep_deleted_residuals(
    agent_manager: Any, *, remove_directories: bool = False
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Drop memory and checkpoints left behind by deleted agents or threads.

    Safe to call from memory slim. Live agents and their current threads are
    kept. Directories under ``agents/`` and ``workspaces/`` whose names match
    no agent are only removed when ``remove_directories`` is true; otherwise
    their paths are returned for a second confirmation. Postgres namespaces
    and checkpoint rows are removed only from databases this instance uses.
    """
    repos = getattr(agent_manager, "_repos", None)
    paths = getattr(agent_manager, "_paths", None)
    config = getattr(agent_manager, "_config", None)
    if repos is None or paths is None or config is None:
        return {"namespaces": 0, "threads": 0, "directories": 0, "directory_paths": []}
    rows = repos.agent_repo.list_all(include_disabled=True)
    live_ids = {str(row.agent_id) for row in rows}
    live_namespaces = {memory_namespace(agent_id) for agent_id in live_ids}
    live_threads: set[str] = set()
    for agent_id in live_ids:
        live_threads |= repos.thread_repo.list_ids_for_agent(agent_id)

    threads_removed = 0
    namespaces_removed = 0
    seen_dsn: set[str] = set()
    if config.database.is_postgresql:
        dsn = config.database.postgresql_conninfo()
        seen_dsn.add(dsn)
        threads_removed += _delete_postgres_orphan_checkpoints(dsn, live_threads)
        namespaces_removed += _delete_postgres_orphan_namespaces(dsn, live_namespaces)
    for row in rows:
        cfg = agent_config_from_row(row)
        workspace = workspace_for_agent_row(row, paths=paths)
        _ns, backend, backend_config, sqlite_path = _memory_location(
            agent_id=row.agent_id,
            cfg=cfg,
            octop_config=config,
            workspace_dir=workspace,
        )
        if backend == "postgres":
            dsn = str((backend_config or {}).get("dsn") or "")
            if dsn and dsn not in seen_dsn:
                seen_dsn.add(dsn)
                threads_removed += _delete_postgres_orphan_checkpoints(dsn, live_threads)
                namespaces_removed += _delete_postgres_orphan_namespaces(dsn, live_namespaces)
            continue
        agent_threads = repos.thread_repo.list_ids_for_agent(row.agent_id)
        files = _sqlite_memory_files(
            cfg, agent_id=row.agent_id, paths=paths, workspace_dir=workspace
        )
        if sqlite_path is not None and sqlite_path.is_file():
            files.append(sqlite_path.resolve())
        for path in dict.fromkeys(files):
            threads_removed += _delete_sqlite_orphan_checkpoints(path, agent_threads)
    directory_paths = [str(path) for path in list_deleted_agent_dirs(paths, live_ids)]
    directories_removed = _remove_deleted_agent_dirs(paths, live_ids) if remove_directories else 0
    return {
        "namespaces": namespaces_removed,
        "threads": threads_removed,
        "directories": directories_removed,
        "directory_paths": directory_paths,
    }


def _delete_sqlite_orphan_checkpoints(path: Path, live_threads: set[str]) -> int:
    if not path.is_file():
        return 0
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000")
        names = {
            str(row[0]) for row in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
        }
        if "checkpoints" not in names:
            return 0
        if live_threads:
            slots = ",".join("?" * len(live_threads))
            orphan_rows = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM checkpoints WHERE thread_id NOT IN ({slots})",
                tuple(live_threads),
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            orphan_rows = conn.execute("SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM checkpoints").fetchall()
        orphan_ids = [str(row[0]) for row in orphan_rows]
        if not orphan_ids:
            return 0
        slots = ",".join("?" * len(orphan_ids))
        for table in ("checkpoints", "checkpoint_blobs", "checkpoint_writes"):
            if table in names:
                conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE thread_id IN ({slots})", tuple(orphan_ids))
        conn.commit()
        return len(orphan_ids)
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _delete_postgres_orphan_checkpoints(dsn: str, live_threads: set[str]) -> int:
    import psycopg

    with psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True) as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT to_regclass('public.checkpoints')")
        found = cur.fetchone()
        if found is None or found[0] is None:
            return 0
        if live_threads:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM checkpoints WHERE NOT (thread_id = ANY(%s))",
                (list(live_threads),),
            )
        else:
            cur.execute("SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM checkpoints")
        orphan_ids = [str(row[0]) for row in cur.fetchall()]
        if not orphan_ids:
            return 0
        for table in ("checkpoints", "checkpoint_blobs", "checkpoint_writes"):
            cur.execute("SELECT to_regclass(%s)", (f"public.{table}",))
            found = cur.fetchone()
            if found is None or found[0] is None:
                continue
            cur.execute(
                f"DELETE FROM public.{table} WHERE thread_id = ANY(%s)",
                (orphan_ids,),
            )
        return len(orphan_ids)


def _delete_postgres_orphan_namespaces(dsn: str, live_namespaces: set[str]) -> int:
    import psycopg

    removed = 0
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True) as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT table_schema, table_name
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE column_name = 'namespace'
              AND table_name = ANY(%s)
              AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
            """,
            (list(_NAMESPACE_TABLES),),
        )
        targets = [(str(schema), str(table)) for schema, table in cur.fetchall()]
        namespaces: set[str] = set()
        for schema, table in targets:
            if _IDENT.fullmatch(schema) is None or _IDENT.fullmatch(table) is None:
                continue
            cur.execute(
                f"SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM {_quote_ident(schema)}.{_quote_ident(table)} "
                "WHERE namespace LIKE 'agent_%'"
            )
            namespaces.update(str(row[0]) for row in cur.fetchall() if row[0])
        stale = sorted(
            ns for ns in namespaces if ns not in live_namespaces and _IDENT.fullmatch(ns)
        )
        if not stale:
            return 0
        for schema, table in targets:
            if _IDENT.fullmatch(schema) is None or _IDENT.fullmatch(table) is None:
                continue
            cur.execute(
                f"DELETE FROM {_quote_ident(schema)}.{_quote_ident(table)} WHERE namespace = ANY(%s)",
                (stale,),
            )
        for namespace in stale:
            for legacy in (namespace, f"{namespace[:56]}__old"):
                if legacy in _SHARED_MEMORY_SCHEMAS or _IDENT.fullmatch(legacy) is None:
                    continue
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = %s",
                    (legacy,),
                )
                if cur.fetchone() is not None:
                    cur.execute(f"DROP SCHEMA {_quote_ident(legacy)} CASCADE")
        removed = len(stale)
    return removed


def list_deleted_agent_dirs(paths: Any, live_ids: set[str]) -> list[Path]:
    """Directories under agents/ and workspaces/ whose names match no agent."""
    found: list[Path] = []
    for parent in (paths.root / "agents", paths.root / "workspaces"):
        if not parent.is_dir():
            continue
        for child in sorted(parent.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name):
            if not child.is_dir() or child.name in live_ids or child.name.startswith("."):
                continue
            found.append(child)
    return found


def _remove_deleted_agent_dirs(paths: Any, live_ids: set[str]) -> int:
    import shutil

    removed = 0
    for child in list_deleted_agent_dirs(paths, live_ids):
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(child)
        except OSError:
            logger.exception("failed to remove leftover agent directory %s", child)
            continue
        removed += 1
    return removed


def _delete_failed(thread_id: str, exc: BaseException) -> OctopError:
    logger.warning("checkpoint delete failed thread=%s", thread_id, exc_info=exc)
    return OctopError(
        ErrorCode.CHECKPOINT_DELETE_FAILED,
        f"could not delete conversation data for thread {thread_id!r}",
    )
````

````python
)


def _read_file_path_from_args(params: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("file_path", "path"):
        raw = params.get(key)
        if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip():
            return raw.strip()
    return ""


def _extension(path: str) -> str:
    cleaned = path.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
    return Path(cleaned).suffix.lower()


def _is_inbound_attachment(path: str) -> bool:
    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    return normalized.startswith("inbound/") or "/inbound/" in normalized


def read_file_block_reason(path: str) -> str | None:
    """Return a rejection message when *path* must not be read via ``read_file``."""
    if not path:
        return None
    ext = _extension(path)
    if ext == ".pdf":
        return (
            f"read_file blocked for binary PDF `{path}`. "
            "Use execute_shell_command with the pdf skill (pdftotext, pdfplumber, etc.) instead."
        )
    if ext in _BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS:
        return (
            f"read_file blocked for binary file `{path}`. "
            "Use execute_shell_command or the matching skill instead."
        )
    if _is_inbound_attachment(path) and ext and ext not in _TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
        return (
            f"read_file blocked for inbound attachment `{path}`. "
            "Use execute_shell_command or the matching skill instead."
        )
    return None


class BinaryReadGuardMiddleware(AgentMiddleware[Any, Any]):
    """Reject read_file on PDF/Office inbound attachments before bytes hit context."""

    async def awrap_tool_call(
        self,
        request: ToolCallRequest,
        handler: Callable[[ToolCallRequest], Awaitable[ToolMessage | Command[Any]]],
    ) -> ToolMessage | Command[Any]:
        tool_call = request.tool_call
        tool_name = str(tool_call.get("name") or "")
        if tool_name != _READ_FILE_TOOL:
            return await handler(request)

        params = tool_call.get("args") or {}
        if not isinstance(params, dict):
            params = {}
        path = _read_file_path_from_args(params)
        reason = read_file_block_reason(path)
        if reason is None:
            return await handler(request)

        logger.info("BinaryReadGuard blocked read_file on %s", path)
        return ToolMessage(
            content=reason,
            tool_call_id=str(tool_call.get("id") or ""),
            status="error",
        )


__all__ = ["BinaryReadGuardMiddleware", "read_file_block_reason"]
````

````python
"""Force browser tool calls onto the current user's isolated profile."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from typing import Any

from langchain.agents.middleware import AgentMiddleware
from langchain_core.messages import ToolMessage
from langgraph.config import get_config
from langgraph.prebuilt.tool_node import ToolCallRequest
from langgraph.types import Command

from octop.infra.utils.browser_media import parse_octop_user_id, user_browser_profile

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_BROWSER_TOOL = "browser_use"
_MISSING_USER = (
    "browser_use blocked: the current turn has no Octop user id, "
    "so a browser profile cannot be isolated."
)


def _bind_browser_profile(request: ToolCallRequest) -> ToolCallRequest | ToolMessage:
    tool_call = request.tool_call
    if str(tool_call.get("name") or "") != _BROWSER_TOOL:
        return request

    configurable = dict(get_config().get("configurable") or {})
    user_id = parse_octop_user_id(configurable.get("user"))
    if user_id is None:
        logger.warning("browser_use blocked: configurable.user is missing or invalid")
        return ToolMessage(
            content=_MISSING_USER,
            tool_call_id=str(tool_call.get("id") or ""),
            status="error",
        )

    raw_args = tool_call.get("args")
    args = dict(raw_args) if isinstance(raw_args, dict) else {}
    args["profile"] = user_browser_profile(user_id)
    return request.override(tool_call={**tool_call, "args": args})


class BrowserProfileMiddleware(AgentMiddleware[Any, Any]):
    """Prevent model-selected profiles from crossing Octop user boundaries."""

    def wrap_tool_call(
        self,
        request: ToolCallRequest,
        handler: Callable[[ToolCallRequest], ToolMessage | Command[Any]],
    ) -> ToolMessage | Command[Any]:
        bound = _bind_browser_profile(request)
        if isinstance(bound, ToolMessage):
            return bound
        return handler(bound)

    async def awrap_tool_call(
        self,
        request: ToolCallRequest,
        handler: Callable[[ToolCallRequest], Awaitable[ToolMessage | Command[Any]]],
    ) -> ToolMessage | Command[Any]:
        bound = _bind_browser_profile(request)
        if isinstance(bound, ToolMessage):
            return bound
        return await handler(bound)


__all__ = ["BrowserProfileMiddleware"]
````

## File: src/octop/infra/agents/middleware/mcp_output_schema.py
````python
"""Output-schema MCP failures for harness builds without ``McpToolErrorMiddleware``."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from typing import Any

from langchain.agents.middleware import AgentMiddleware
from langchain_core.messages import ToolMessage
from langgraph.errors import GraphBubbleUp
from langgraph.prebuilt.tool_node import ToolCallRequest
from langgraph.types import Command

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_MAX_DETAIL_CHARS = 2000

_OUTPUT_NOTE = (
    "The tool accepted the arguments and then failed its own output schema. "
    "Do not retry this call by changing the arguments."
)


def _is_output_schema_message(message: str) -> bool:
    text = message.lstrip()
    return (
        text.startswith("Invalid structured content returned by tool ")
        or text.startswith("Invalid schema for tool ")
        or "has an output schema but did not return structured content" in text
    )


def _find_output_schema_error(exc: BaseException) -> RuntimeError | None:
    if isinstance(exc, RuntimeError) and _is_output_schema_message(str(exc)):
        return exc
    if isinstance(exc, BaseExceptionGroup):
        for sub in exc.exceptions:
            found = _find_output_schema_error(sub)
            if found is not None:
                return found
    return None


def _has_control_flow(exc: BaseException) -> bool:
    if isinstance(exc, (GraphBubbleUp, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit)):
        return True
    if isinstance(exc, BaseExceptionGroup):
        return any(_has_control_flow(sub) for sub in exc.exceptions)
    return False


def _error_text(tool_name: str, error: RuntimeError) -> str:
    detail = str(error).strip() or "invalid structured content"
    if len(detail) > _MAX_DETAIL_CHARS:
        detail = detail[:_MAX_DETAIL_CHARS] + "..."
    return f"MCP tool `{tool_name}` failed output-schema validation: {detail}\n\n{_OUTPUT_NOTE}"


def _soften(request: ToolCallRequest, error: RuntimeError) -> ToolMessage:
    tool_call = request.tool_call
    tool_name = str(tool_call.get("name") or "")
    logger.warning(
        "MCP tool %s failed output-schema validation: %s",
        tool_name,
        str(error)[:500],
    )
    return ToolMessage(
        content=_error_text(tool_name, error),
        name=tool_name,
        tool_call_id=str(tool_call.get("id") or ""),
        status="error",
    )


class McpOutputSchemaMiddleware(AgentMiddleware[Any, Any]):
    def wrap_tool_call(
        self,
        request: ToolCallRequest,
        handler: Callable[[ToolCallRequest], ToolMessage | Command[Any]],
    ) -> ToolMessage | Command[Any]:
        try:
            return handler(request)
        except BaseException as exc:
            if _has_control_flow(exc):
                raise
            error = _find_output_schema_error(exc)
            if error is None:
                raise
            return _soften(request, error)

    async def awrap_tool_call(
        self,
        request: ToolCallRequest,
        handler: Callable[[ToolCallRequest], Awaitable[ToolMessage | Command[Any]]],
    ) -> ToolMessage | Command[Any]:
        try:
            return await handler(request)
        except BaseException as exc:
            if _has_control_flow(exc):
                raise
            error = _find_output_schema_error(exc)
            if error is None:
                raise
            return _soften(request, error)


def harness_handles_mcp_tool_errors() -> bool:
    try:
        from octop_harness.middleware.mcp_tool_error import McpToolErrorMiddleware
    except ImportError:
        return False
    return McpToolErrorMiddleware is not None


__all__ = ["McpOutputSchemaMiddleware", "harness_handles_mcp_tool_errors"]
````

````python
"""Health-aware and context-safe model failover for AUTO-routed turns."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Sequence
from typing import Any, Literal, cast

from langchain.agents.middleware import AgentMiddleware, ModelRequest, ModelResponse
from langchain.agents.middleware.model_retry import ModelRetryMiddleware
from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage
from langgraph.errors import GraphBubbleUp
from octop_harness.context_usage import breakdown_from_model_request
from octop_harness.middleware.runtime import runtime_config
from octop_harness.middleware.turn_model import latest_human_needs_multimodal

from octop.i18n.domains.stream import model_retry_failure_prompt
from octop.infra.agents.providers.health import (
    FailureScope,
    ModelHealthRegistry,
    classify_model_failure,
)
from octop.infra.agents.providers.store import AutoRouteCandidate
from octop.infra.agents.settings.runtime_limits import CONFIGURABLE_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

AUTO_ROUTE_CONFIG_KEY = "octop_auto_route"
_CONTEXT_SAFETY_RATIO = 0.9


def _configurable(request: ModelRequest[Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    config = runtime_config(request)
    configurable = config.get("configurable") if isinstance(config, dict) else None
    return configurable if isinstance(configurable, dict) else {}


def _estimated_input_tokens(request: ModelRequest[Any]) -> int:
    return sum(breakdown_from_model_request(request).values())


def _fits_context(
    candidate: AutoRouteCandidate,
    estimated_tokens: int,
    route_cap: int | None = None,
) -> bool:
    cap = candidate.max_input_tokens
    if route_cap is not None and route_cap > 0:
        cap = min(cap, route_cap) if cap > 0 else route_cap
    if cap <= 0:
        return True
    return estimated_tokens <= int(cap * _CONTEXT_SAFETY_RATIO)


class SafeModelFailoverMiddleware(AgentMiddleware[Any, Any]):
    """Retry one model, then switch only for AUTO and safe failure classes."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        health: ModelHealthRegistry,
        candidates: Callable[[str, bool], Sequence[AutoRouteCandidate]],
        model_for_ref: Callable[[str], Any],
        max_retries: int,
        initial_delay: float,
        max_delay: float,
        on_failure: Callable[[Exception], str] | Literal["error"] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._health = health
        self._candidates = candidates
        self._model_for_ref = model_for_ref
        self._on_failure = on_failure
        self._retry = ModelRetryMiddleware(
            max_retries=max_retries,
            initial_delay=initial_delay,
            max_delay=max_delay,
            on_failure="error",
        )

    def _failure_response(self, exc: Exception) -> ModelResponse[Any]:
        if self._on_failure == "error":
            raise exc
        content = (
            self._on_failure(exc)
            if self._on_failure is not None
            else model_retry_failure_prompt(exc, "en")
        )
        return ModelResponse(result=[AIMessage(content=content)])

    def _route(self, request: ModelRequest[Any]) -> tuple[str, bool]:
        configurable = _configurable(request)
        ref = configurable.get("model")
        return (
            ref.strip() if isinstance(ref, str) else "",
            configurable.get(AUTO_ROUTE_CONFIG_KEY) is True,
        )

    def _fallbacks(self, request: ModelRequest[Any], current_ref: str) -> list[AutoRouteCandidate]:
        needs_multimodal = latest_human_needs_multimodal(list(request.messages or []))
        estimated = _estimated_input_tokens(request)
        raw_route_cap = _configurable(request).get(CONFIGURABLE_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS)
        route_cap = raw_route_cap if isinstance(raw_route_cap, int) else None
        return [
            candidate
            for candidate in self._candidates(current_ref, needs_multimodal)
            if candidate.ref != current_ref
            and self._health.is_routable(candidate.ref)
            and _fits_context(candidate, estimated, route_cap)
        ]

    def _record_failure(self, ref: str, exc: Exception) -> bool:
        decision = classify_model_failure(exc)
        if decision.scope is not FailureScope.NONE:
            self._health.record_failure(ref, kind=decision.kind, scope=decision.scope)
        return decision.failover

    def wrap_model_call(
        self,
        request: ModelRequest[Any],
        handler: Callable[[ModelRequest[Any]], ModelResponse[Any]],
    ) -> ModelResponse[Any]:
        current_ref, automatic = self._route(request)
        last_error: Exception | None = None
        attempts: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
        if not automatic or not current_ref or self._health.begin_attempt(current_ref):
            attempts.append((current_ref, request.model))
        if automatic and current_ref:
            attempts.extend(
                (candidate.ref, self._model_for_ref(candidate.ref))
                for candidate in self._fallbacks(request, current_ref)
            )

        for ref, model in attempts:
            if automatic and ref != current_ref and not self._health.begin_attempt(ref):
                continue
            routed = request if model is request.model else request.override(model=model)
            if automatic and ref and ref != current_ref:
                _configurable(request)["model"] = ref
            try:
                response = self._retry.wrap_model_call(routed, handler)
            except GraphBubbleUp:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc
                may_failover = self._record_failure(ref, exc)
                if not automatic or not may_failover:
                    return self._failure_response(exc)
                logger.warning("AUTO model route failed; trying next candidate: model=%s", ref)
                continue
            self._health.record_success(ref)
            return cast(ModelResponse[Any], response)

        return self._failure_response(
            last_error or RuntimeError("no healthy AUTO model is available")
        )

    async def awrap_model_call(
        self,
        request: ModelRequest[Any],
        handler: Callable[[ModelRequest[Any]], Awaitable[ModelResponse[Any]]],
    ) -> ModelResponse[Any]:
        current_ref, automatic = self._route(request)
        last_error: Exception | None = None
        attempts: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
        if not automatic or not current_ref or self._health.begin_attempt(current_ref):
            attempts.append((current_ref, request.model))
        if automatic and current_ref:
            attempts.extend(
                (candidate.ref, self._model_for_ref(candidate.ref))
                for candidate in self._fallbacks(request, current_ref)
            )

        for ref, model in attempts:
            if automatic and ref != current_ref and not self._health.begin_attempt(ref):
                continue
            routed = request if model is request.model else request.override(model=model)
            if automatic and ref and ref != current_ref:
                _configurable(request)["model"] = ref
            try:
                response = await self._retry.awrap_model_call(routed, handler)
            except GraphBubbleUp:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc
                may_failover = self._record_failure(ref, exc)
                if not automatic or not may_failover:
                    return self._failure_response(exc)
                logger.warning("AUTO model route failed; trying next candidate: model=%s", ref)
                continue
            self._health.record_success(ref)
            return cast(ModelResponse[Any], response)

        return self._failure_response(
            last_error or RuntimeError("no healthy AUTO model is available")
        )


__all__ = [
    "AUTO_ROUTE_CONFIG_KEY",
    "AutoRouteCandidate",
    "SafeModelFailoverMiddleware",
]
````
